Name: Aaron Gibbs
Intro description:
Hi, I'm Aaron. I'm a Wealth Manager with Palladian Asset Management based in Richmond, Virginia. I help clients with retirement planning, investment management, income planning, individual retirement accounts, company retirement accounts, and general investing.

I believe strong planning starts with listening. Once I understand what clients want to accomplish, I help build strategies tailored to their goals and revisit those goals throughout the relationship.
Quote: I listen closely to what clients want, then build a portfolio and planning strategy around their goals.
Team description: Palladian Asset Management was built around a simple idea: that a small number of families, served well, is the best way to do this work. We are advisors, fiduciaries, and long-term partners, not a sales channel.
Service description 1: Transition into your golden years with confidence. Our goal is to see to it that you're prepared for the unpredictable. Let us turn your retirement dreams into actionable plans.
Service eyebrow 2: STRATEGIC, DATA-DRIVEN INVESTING TO TARGET AMBITIOUS RESULTS
Service description 2: End-to-end investment management focused on tailoring portfolios to each client's specific circumstances and preferences. Our holistic approach will take into consideration all facets of your situation along with current economic data to optimize your portfolio's risk and return.
Service description 3: Understand your income with an annual plan showing where cash flow is generated, and why. This weaves together Restricted Stock Units (RSU) flows, stock option exercises, long-term capital gains, Roth Conversions, etc.
Service description 4: With streamlined plan management, our goal is to provide an exceptional experience for business owners and participants. Serving as a 3(38) Investment Fiduciary, Savvy assumes full responsibility for the selection and oversight of funds and model portfolios, thereby mitigating plan liability risks for the plan sponsor.
Full description:
Aaron Gibbs is a Wealth Manager with 18 years of experience in financial services. He earned a degree in Managerial Economics from Hampden-Sydney College and has worked for the Federal Reserve Bank, a Fortune 500 company, and several wealth management businesses.

Aaron works with a wide range of clients, including doctors, lawyers, business owners, and hardworking families. His work often centers on retirement planning, investment management, income planning, individual retirement accounts, company retirement accounts, and general investing.

Outside of work, Aaron has coached basketball for Upward and RockIt Sports. He has also been involved with Rotary Club. Much of his time now is spent supporting his three children and their busy schedules.

Faq answer 2: I work with many types of clients, including doctors, lawyers, business owners, and blue-collar families.
Faq answer 3: My work includes wealth management, individual retirement accounts, company retirement accounts, general investing, retirement planning, and income planning.
Faq answer 4: I help clients build strategies tailored to their goals. Those goals are discussed early in the relationship and reviewed over time as life changes.
Faq answer 5: I love the day clients call and tell me they are retiring and are happy they are able to do so. It is also rewarding to hear when clients succeed in other parts of life.

Name: Aaron Peloquin

I specialize in helping clients plan for financial independence through comprehensive, tax-efficient wealth strategies built around their unique values, goals, and life mission. My past experience as a consultant and risk management professional provided the foundation for the advisor that I am today. Those opportunities provided me with a broad perspective of the financial industry and helped to develop the skills necessary to analyze and assess my clients' financial goals and their needs as they seek financial independence.
Quote: I knew this was the right path for me. Making the transition was one of the best decisions I’ve made. I now have the privilege of guiding clients toward their goals and dreams, and nothing is more rewarding than seeing the positive impact of a well-crafted financial plan.

Service eyebrow 2: STRATEGIC, DATA-DRIVEN INVESTING FOR AMBITIOUS RESULTS
Service description 2: Personalized wealth management is aimed to help our clients grow and protect their assets. We use a holistic approach to financial planning that integrates tax strategy, trust & estate planning, and risk management.

Full description:
Aaron specializes in helping clients plan for financial independence through comprehensive, tax-efficient wealth strategies built around each client’s unique values, goals, and life mission. Aaron works with his clients to build a personalized wealth plan, by developing a trusting relationship through actively listening and understanding each client’s goals, investing experiences, and risks and fears. With over 25 years of experience in the financial services industry, Aaron understands the complexities involved in helping clients navigate their financial goals including investments, taxes, risk management, and giving and legacy strategies.

Prior to becoming a financial advisor, Aaron worked as a consultant with a leading global CPA and consulting firm, helping financial services companies improve operations and compliance risk management. He later led operational risk teams at local firms and a Minneapolis hedge fund, deepening his interest in investing and the markets. This experience built the foundation for his advisory work, giving him a broad industry perspective and the ability to assess clients’ goals as they pursue financial independence. Today, Aaron's team serves employees with stock compensation at private and public companies, as well as consultants and business owners. They also guide individuals nearing or in retirement, with expertise in stock compensation planning, tax mitigation, retirement planning, and investment management.
Faq answer 1:
My journey to becoming a financial advisor started with a conversation that changed my perspective. While working in corporate risk management, a close friend, who was also my financial advisor, noticed that I wasn’t truly fulfilled in my career. He pointed out that with my CPA background and passion for helping people, I had the skills to make a real impact as a financial advisor. At first, I brushed it off, but as more friends and colleagues echoed the same sentiment, I started to seriously explore the profession.

As I learned more, met with advisors, and saw firsthand how I could help families build a secure financial future, I knew this was the right path for me. Making the transition was one of the best decisions I’ve made. I now have the privilege of guiding clients toward their goals and dreams, and nothing is more rewarding than seeing the positive impact of a well-crafted wealth plan.
Faq answer 2: I specialize in working with high-earning and high-net-worth clients interested in growing their wealth for their retirement, and their families with a comprehensive wealth plan. Having held leadership positions in corporate America, I enjoy working with business owners, senior management and executives to navigate the tax complexities that come with high income, RSUs, ISOs, and deferred compensation plans.
Faq answer 3: My expertise lies in developing comprehensive wealth plans with a strong emphasis on tax efficiency, Social Security strategies, and estate planning. As a CPA, I leverage my background to help clients structure their finances in a way that minimizes tax burdens and maximizes long-term wealth preservation.
Faq answer 4: I help clients navigate and understand the complexities of the tax code and work alongside their estate attorney(s) to create the estate plans that match their wishes  while being as tax efficient as possible. My focus is on ensuring that their legacy is preserved. This may include using trust structures to remove assets from their estate prior to reaching Federal and/or State estate tax limits. By proactively planning, I can help my clients protect their wealth for future generations, while staying aligned with their long-term goals.
Faq answer 5: My favorite part of working with clients is getting to know them and building trust-based relationships with each one of them. I enjoy getting to know each client on a personal level and understanding what matters to them. I also find great fulfillment in educating my clients on financial planning and tax strategies that help them save on taxes and achieve their goals. Seeing clients gain confidence in their financial future is what drives me every day.
Faq answer 6: What I value most about working with Savvy is the innovative technology, robust support model, and collaborative environment. Savvy’s platform allows me to provide clients with a seamless, all-in-one financial experience, ensuring they have a clear, real-time view of their financial picture. The firm’s strong support structure empowers me to focus on what matters most, which will always remain helping my clients achieve their goals. Savvy’s dedication to a collaborative culture allows me to focus on delivering the best possible strategies and solutions tailored to each client’s unique needs.

Full description:
Aaron, a proud Wisconsin native, graduated from Wisconsin Lutheran College in 2000 with a Bachelor's degree in business administration. He kick-started his career in the operations and trading department of a small local broker-dealer. Afterward, he made the move to San Diego, and since then, he has been actively involved in the financial industry. Driven by his passion for continuous growth, Aaron obtained his CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNING™ (CFP®) designation in 2011, complementing his securities licensing with insurance expertise. Prior to joining Savvy, he was a Senior Lead Wealth Advisor at a prominent San Diego RIA. Currently, Aaron resides in the Del Mar area of San Diego alongside his girlfriend and beloved companion, Buddy, who happens to be his dog.

While remaining a devoted supporter of his hometown teams—the Packers, Bucks, Brewers, and Badgers—Aaron has shifted his focus from basketball to pickleball as his preferred active pursuit. Additionally, he has recently embraced the exhilarating journey of learning to box.

Name: Albert Pinedo
Intro description:
Hi 👋🏼 I'm Albert. I advise corporate executives, entrepreneurs, and wealth-builders to shift from the noise of managing financial complexity to a state of total clarity, backed by a custom blueprint deliberately aligned with what matters most in life.

At our practice, we believe building wealth is just the baseline. Many professionals and business owners reach a threshold where they’ve achieved incredible career milestones, yet find a more profound question emerging: How do I align these resources to live with deep intentionality? We step in as dedicated partners at that exact crossroad, guiding our clients as they streamline their financial moving pieces so they can focus on the experiences, people, and pursuits that give life true meaning.

Together, we transform wealth from a complex web of numbers into a protective, highly optimized engine to give you the ultimate freedom to accomplish what really matters today and secure your legacy for tomorrow.
Quote: I help clients translate overwhelming financial data into actionable, intentional choices to ensure their wealth serves their actual life, rather than just existing as a set of numbers on a statement.
Team description:
Albert Pinedo and Luis Villavicencio partner to deliver a distinct, education-first approach to wealth management for families, corporate executives, and business owners throughout the Tampa Bay area. While they bring diverse career backgrounds. Albert focusing on advanced private wealth strategies and portfolio architecture, and Luis drawing from over a decade of institutional and operational leadership. They are bound by a shared conviction: a successful financial life cannot be mass-produced.

Together, they advise seamlessly across both English and Spanish-speaking dynamics, blending technical precision with a deep appreciation for cross-cultural nuances. They act as dedicated advocates behind the scenes for clients who value transparent communication, comprehensive tax integration, and a unified financial framework that honors where they stand today while paving a clear path forward. Grounded, accessible, and deeply invested in their clients' financial security, they provide the steady momentum that keeps your long-term goals moving forward.

Full description:
My trajectory in wealth management bridges rigorous institutional experience with an independent, entrepreneurial drive. Spanning more than two decades in global financial markets, I have dedicated my career to decoding complex economic landscapes for professionals, multi-generational families, and business owners.

I am a graduate of the Lubar College of Business at the University of Wisconsin-Milwaukee, and I hold the Certified Private Wealth Advisor® (CPWA®) designation, an advanced credential completed through the Yale University School of Management. The CPWA® curriculum requires a multidisciplinary mastery of advanced wealth management disciplines, specifically focusing on complex tax mitigation, asset protection, estate preservation, and legacy structures. This specialized training allows me to look at wealth through a wide-angle lens, protecting clients against concentrated market risks, minimizing structural tax drag, and smoothing the transition of family assets. Prior to aligning with Savvy, I successfully founded and scaled my own independent advisory firm, Marketwise Asset Management, establishing a deep-seated commitment to providing institutional-grade portfolio oversight delivered through a warm, deeply individualized client experience fluent in both domestic and international dynamics.
Faq answer 1:
Long before navigating private wealth, there were green-screen spreadsheets.

Growing up, the financial world wasn't just an abstract concept; it was a frequent backdrop to daily life. My mother dedicated her career to JPMorgan Chase, and walking through those bustling corporate corridors as a kid sparked an early fascination with how global wealth moves. By high school, while my peers were exploring other interests, I was completely absorbed in personal finance courses and early spreadsheet design. I later paired this analytical mindset with practical technical experience, working within my university's IT infrastructure department while earning my degree in finance and marketing.

My professional career took root at The Bank of New York Clearing (now Pershing LLC), but an unexpected chapter soon took me back to my birth country of Venezuela. There, I immersed myself in international wealth management, handling private client portfolios for major institutions like CitiGold Private Client and StateTrust. Working alongside elite, seasoned executives taught me how to manage deep financial complexity, but it also crystallized my desire to build an independent practice focused entirely on client alignment.

Following rigorous study and insightful strategic mentorship at the New York Institute of Finance, I took the entrepreneurial leap and established Marketwise Asset Management in Florida in 2012. Operating an independent firm for a decade grounded me in the realities of business ownership—understanding the unique exposures business owners face, the real-world weight of critical financial choices, and the absolute necessity of transparent advice. I brought that exact blend of institutional knowledge and independent care to Savvy.
Faq answer 2:
We primarily serve corporate executives, senior managers, and business owners who have achieved substantial professional success and require a higher level of financial coordination to protect what they’ve built.

Many of our clients are what we consider intentional builders. They look beyond basic stock picking; they are navigating pivotal, complex transitions—whether that involves unwinding a highly concentrated equity position, structuring a business for an eventual exit, navigating cross-border assets, or establishing an estate framework for the next generation. They value an advisor who fluently speaks both the language of corporate strategy and family dynamics, and who can help them optimize their assets to focus on what truly matters in life.
Faq answer 3: In the ever-evolving markets of today, I am dedicated to providing meticulous and forward-thinking investment management solutions. My career focus lies in investment management, equity analysis, and financial planning, aimed at aiding clients in tax planning, executive compensation and portfolio management. Each client strategy is rigorously tailored, considering factors such as tax implications, liquidity, and risk tolerance. I devote personal attention to every portfolio, recognizing that each client possesses unique investment goals, aiming to align opportunities with objectives.
Faq answer 4: We help clients construct financial blueprints that mirror the life they want to lead. Every client relationship starts with a clean slate and a goals-based planning process, never a standardized model. From there, we deploy specific, advanced mechanisms tailored to your exact career and lifestyle stage. For corporate executives facing concentrated equity risks or restricted stock issues, we implement protective strategies such as equity collars, covered call writing, or exchange funds to systematically diversify positions while managing capital gains exposure. For our business owners, we emphasize early pre-sale planning and trust mapping to insulate business value long before a transaction occurs. For those approaching retirement, we systematically restructure wealth into predictable, tax-efficient income systems designed to replace a corporate salary seamlessly.
Faq answer 5:
For me, it is the opportunity to step past the balance sheets and build a deep, human connection that goes far beyond a traditional, transactional business relationship. I want to be the steady, reliable support my clients can lean on when life brings unexpected changes, major transitions, or complex decisions.

There is immense satisfaction in helping someone strip away the financial noise and navigate the intricacies of wealth so they can focus entirely on what brings them joy. When a client realizes their assets are organized, fully optimized, and actively serving their true purpose in life, you can physically see the weight lift off their shoulders. Becoming that trusted, lifelong anchor for a family to help them protect what matters most. This is exactly why I do this work.
Faq answer 6: I love how dynamic the team is within operations and advisor support. The technology platform is outstanding for both clients and advisors. But most importantly, I encounter amazing human beings throughout the organization!

Name: Alex Barnes
Intro description: Hello! 👋 I’m Alex, a dedicated financial advisor with a passion for helping clients achieve their financial dreams through personalized, tax-optimized strategies. With a background in banking and years of experience in financial planning, I bring a unique blend of expertise and empathy to my work, focusing on income planning and tax efficiency to guide clients toward their goals. My journey to becoming a financial advisor was driven by a desire to make a meaningful impact, building trusted relationships that empower pre-retirees to plan confidently for their future. Outside of work, you can find me hitting the golf course, playing pickup basketball, or getting in a good workout. Family time is especially important to me, and I love nothing more than cheering on my daughter at her soccer games and my son on his football team. On weekends, you can often find me outside by the grill, experimenting with new BBQ techniques and smoking meat for friends and family.
Quote: My approach is all about creating personalized, tax-smart strategies that empower my clients to achieve their dreams with confidence. By taking the time to truly understand their unique goals, both short and long-term, and leveraging advanced planning tools, I guide them through every financial decision, celebrating each milestone we reach together as if it were my own.
Service eyebrow 1: TAKE CONTROL OF YOUR FINANCIAL FUTURE
Service description 1: Personalized wealth management helps our clients protect their assets. We use a holistic approach to financial planning that integrates tax strategy, trust & estate planning, and risk management.
Service eyebrow 2: STRIVING TO MINIMIZE YOUR TAX BURDEN
Service description 2: We aim to take the ambiguity out of tax planning by utilizing tax-reducing strategies that encompass your overall tax liability. We do it by putting together a game plan that is specific to your needs.
Service description 3: Understand your income with an annual plan showing where cash flow is generated, and why. This weaves together Restricted Stock Units (RSU) flows, stock option exercises, long-term capital gains, Roth Conversions, etc.
Full description:
With a foundation of experience in banking and a deep passion for personalized financial guidance, Alex has dedicated his career to helping pre-retirees achieve their dreams through thoughtful, tax-optimized strategies. His expertise in income planning and tax efficiency, paired with advanced financial tools, allows him to craft tailored plans that align with each client’s unique goals. What drives Alex is building meaningful relationships and celebrating the joy of seeing clients gain confidence in their financial future.

Alex claims the most rewarding part of his work is witnessing the relief and excitement clients feel when they achieve a milestone they’ve planned together—whether it’s preparing for a secure retirement, funding a dream purchase, or creating a legacy for their loved ones. Every step of the journey reinforces his commitment to providing clear, strategic support that makes a real difference. His goal is simple, to help clients keep more of what they earn and invest with purpose, so they can live the life they envision.

Outside of work, Alex enjoys staying active, whether that’s hitting the golf course, playing pickup basketball, or getting in a good workout. Family time is especially important, and he loves nothing more than cheering on his daughter at her soccer games and his son on his football team. On weekends, you can often find Alex outside by the grill, experimenting with new BBQ techniques and smoking meat for friends and family.
Faq answer 1: I began my career in banking, but I quickly realized that I wanted to make a deeper impact by working with individuals and families on a more personal and comprehensive level - that is where my true passion lies. That realization led me to financial planning and ultimately becoming a financial advisor. In this role, I’ve found the perfect balance: building meaningful relationships while helping clients with financial decisions that align with their goals. It’s incredibly rewarding to provide the kind of personalized support that can truly change someone’s financial future.
Faq answer 2: I primarily work with pre-retirees who are established in their careers and recognize the importance of proactive planning. These clients often come to me with both short- and long-term goals and they understand that having a professional guide can help them optimize their strategy and potentially reach those goals more efficiently. They’re thoughtful about their future and value expert support in making confident, informed decisions.
Faq answer 3: My areas of expertise are income planning and tax optimization. I believe these are two critical components, and I incorporate them into every client’s financial strategy, whether they’re preparing for retirement or already enjoying it. I leverage advanced financial planning software to analyze income flows and tax implications, helping my clients make informed decisions. My goal is to create tailored strategies that not only support their lifestyle but also maximize tax efficiency over the long term.
Faq answer 4: My strategies are always tailored to each of my client’s unique situations, but a core part of my approach is helping my clients understand how their income, savings, and distribution decisions impact their overall financial picture. I use tax and income planning tools to illustrate how different strategies can affect both their short- and long-term goals. By modeling various scenarios, I can help clients make informed decisions that align with their values, minimize tax exposure, and support a more efficient path to financial independence.
Faq answer 5: My favorite part of working with clients is seeing the joy and relief that comes when they achieve a goal we’ve planned for together. Whether it’s saving for a major purchase, preparing for retirement, or creating a legacy for the next generation, I truly take pride in being part of that journey. In my opinion, there’s nothing more rewarding than watching one of my clients feel confident and excited about their future, and knowing I had a hand in helping make that possible. Each milestone we reach together deepens our relationship and reinforces why I love what I do.
Faq answer 6: What I value most about working with Savvy is the ability it gives me to truly focus on my clients. The platform’s streamlined tools and technology allow me to work more efficiently, I am able to complete important tasks faster so I can spend more time focused on building relationships and offering thoughtful guidance to my clients. The support model at Savvy empowers me to deliver a high level of service while ensuring every strategy I create is both personalized and forward-thinking. It’s a structure that puts my clients first, and that’s what matters most.

Name: Alex Duncan
Intro description:
Hi 👋 I'm Alex. Before becoming a financial advisor, I spent 15 years working in medical device sales and leadership. Today, I help medical device and pharmaceutical professionals navigate many of the same financial decisions I encountered during my own career.

My work centers on comprehensive financial planning, investment management, and stock-based compensation, including RSUs, stock options, and ESPPs. I understand how variable income, taxes, company stock, and career decisions can intersect. At Duncan Wealth Management, I help clients bring those pieces together into a flexible financial plan that can evolve as their careers and priorities change.
Quote: I help medical device and pharma professionals create flexible financial plans that bring their equity compensation, taxes, career decisions, and long-term goals together.
Service eyebrow 1: TAKE CONTROL OF YOUR FINANCIAL FUTURE
Service description 1: Personalized wealth management helps our clients protect their assets. We use a holistic approach to financial planning that integrates tax strategy, trust & estate planning, and risk management.
Service eyebrow 2: STRATEGIC, DATA-DRIVEN INVESTING TO PURSUE YOUR GOALS
Service description 2: End-to-end investment management focused on tailoring portfolios to each client's specific circumstances and preferences. Our holistic approach will take into consideration all facets of your situation along with current economic data to help manage your portfolio's risk and return.
Service eyebrow 3: STRATEGIC PLANNING OF YOUR FINANCIAL AND NON-FINANCIAL COMPENSATION
Service description 3: We are here to guide you through your compensation negotiation, helping you secure a package that aligns with both your short-term needs and long-term goals.
Service description 4: We help clients make informed decisions around stock options, RSUs, ESPPs, and other equity awards. Our approach integrates tax planning, diversification strategies, and long-term wealth planning to help you manage concentration risk and align your equity compensation with your broader financial goals.
Full description:
Alex Duncan took an unconventional path to wealth management. After earning his degree in economics with the intention of entering the industry, his career instead led him into medical device sales and leadership, where he spent 15 years.

Alex began at Bausch + Lomb as a phone sales representative and worked his way up to national account manager. He later joined Sight Sciences during its earlier stages and was with the company through its IPO. Along the way, he experienced many of the compensation opportunities and decisions that medical device and pharmaceutical professionals encounter, including participating in an employee stock purchase plan, receiving RSUs, and exercising stock options.

Those experiences also showed Alex how complicated equity compensation can become when taxes, timing, diversification, and long-term financial goals are considered together. His own financial decisions ultimately helped shape the work he does today.

Four years ago, Alex transitioned into wealth management and launched Duncan Wealth Management. He now works primarily with medical device and pharmaceutical professionals, from sales representatives to senior executives, helping them understand how their compensation fits into their broader financial lives.

As a CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER® professional, Alex focuses on comprehensive financial planning, investment management, early retirement planning, and stock-based compensation. His firsthand industry experience gives him an understanding of the career paths, variable compensation structures, and financial decisions his clients regularly face.
Faq answer 1:
I earned my degree in economics with the intention of working in wealth management, but my career initially took me in a different direction. I spent 15 years in medical device sales and leadership before making the transition into financial planning four years ago and launching Duncan Wealth Management.

During my medical device career, I dealt firsthand with many of the financial decisions my clients face today. I participated in an ESPP, received RSUs, exercised stock options, and experienced the tax and diversification decisions that come with accumulating company stock.

Those experiences played an important role in my decision to become an advisor. I wanted to work with people from the medical device and pharmaceutical industries who were navigating the same kinds of questions I had faced throughout my career.
Faq answer 2:
I primarily work with medical device and pharmaceutical professionals, from sales representatives to CEOs.

These professionals often have financial lives that include variable compensation, high tax brackets, company stock, RSUs, stock options, ESPPs, and important career decisions. I help them understand how those pieces fit together and how decisions made during their careers can affect longer-term goals such as early retirement.
Faq answer 3:
My work focuses on comprehensive financial planning, investment management, early retirement planning, and stock-based compensation.

I frequently work with RSUs, stock options, and employee stock purchase plans. Because these benefits can affect taxes, investment concentration, cash flow, and retirement planning at the same time, I believe it is important to evaluate them as part of the broader financial picture rather than as separate decisions.
Faq answer 4:
I help clients create flexible financial plans that can adapt as their careers, compensation, and priorities change.

For medical device and pharmaceutical professionals, that can include evaluating when to exercise or sell company stock, planning around RSUs and ESPPs, managing investment concentration, considering tax implications, and determining how those decisions affect goals such as early retirement.

Rather than looking at each decision in isolation, I help clients understand how the different parts of their financial lives interact.
Faq answer 5:
My favorite part is helping take some of the weight of financial decision-making off a client's shoulders.

When we put a clear plan in place, clients can better understand where they stand, what decisions need their attention, and how those choices connect to their goals. That can allow them to spend more of their time and energy on other priorities, whether that means being with their family, advancing their career, or pursuing something else that matters to them.
Faq answer 6:
The combination of Savvy's team and technology allows me to spend more of my time working directly with clients.

There is significant support behind the scenes, from administrative work to investment analysis and management to marketing. Having those resources available allows me to spend less time on operational tasks and more time helping clients work through the financial decisions that matter to them.

Full description:
Andrew George brings 20 years of financial services experience to his work with individuals and families. His connection to financial planning began early, inspired in part by his father, who was an early CFP® professional in Mississippi. This experience gave Andrew a firsthand perspective on the role a financial advisor can play in helping families make thoughtful financial decisions throughout different stages of life.

Andrew attended the University of Mississippi, where he earned a Bachelor of Business Administration in Managerial Finance with an emphasis in Investment Analysis. After beginning his career in life insurance and financial planning, he returned to Ole Miss to earn his Juris Doctor degree. While in law school, he received the Dean’s Distinguished Service Award and served as Attorney General for the Law School Student Body.

After completing his law degree in 2008, Andrew worked alongside his father in a Registered Investment Advisory practice before continuing his career in financial services. His legal education gives him an additional perspective when reviewing estate, tax, business succession, and wealth-transfer considerations and coordinating with clients’ attorneys and tax professionals.

Andrew’s work centers on long-term relationships. He serves professionals, business owners, retirees, and families with complex financial lives who want their planning, investments, retirement strategy, and legacy considerations viewed together rather than separately. He also incorporates behavioral investment counseling into his work, helping clients remain disciplined when markets and personal circumstances change.

Outside of his professional work, Andrew has served as an Elder and as President of the Christian Preschool Board of Directors at First Presbyterian Church Starkville. He is an Eagle Scout and has volunteered with the Boy Scouts of America. He has also served his local community through homeowner association and volunteer fire district board roles.

Andrew and his wife, Stacey, are the parents of twins, Drew and Katie Clay.

Ashley Crane is a North Carolina native who has spent her life building strong connections within the communities she calls home. She grew up in a small town north of Greensboro and attended North Carolina State University in Raleigh, where she studied Business Management with concentrations in marketing and finance.

Ashley began her career in banking before moving into small business venture capital. While working with business owners, she saw how personal financial instability could affect their ability to pursue professional goals. Those experiences, along with conversations with her own financial advisor, inspired her to enter financial planning.

After seven years in the financial industry, Ashley became a financial advisor at age 28. Today, she helps clients work through retirement decisions, tax-aware income distribution, military retiree benefits, divorce transitions, cash flow management, estate protection, and long-term planning.

Ashley lives in Garner, North Carolina, with her husband and their rescue boxer. She is active in her community and attends Amelia Christian Church in Clayton. Outside of work, she enjoys traveling with her husband, playing and teaching piano, gardening, and searching for ice cream shops throughout rural North Carolina. She is also a proud supporter of the NC State Wolfpack and the Carolina Hurricanes.

Berkely Arrants is the Founder of Horizon Advisory Group, LLC, a Houston based personal and business financial planning firm. Her passion for helping people, and her expertise in taking complex situations and making them simple, led her to become a financial planner. Berkely holds the designations of Certified Financial Planner®, Certified Investment Management Analyst®, and Certified Retirement Planning Counselor®.

Berkely specializes in closely held and family business planning, including transition, employee retention, executive benefits, owner retirement, valuation, and estate planning. She also focuses on personal financial planning, helping owners exit their businesses strategically.

On the personal financial side, through the use of comprehensive financial planning, Berkely helps her clients establish and refine their goals by listening carefully to what is important to them now and in the future. She then designs a strategic, personalized path towards accomplishing their unique objectives.

Berkely has been involved in a number of Boards over the years including Volunteers in Medicine, the First Presbyterian Day School, The Houston Children’s Chorus, The University of Pennsylvania Alumni Club of Houston, and she was an Elder at First Presbyterian Church in Hilton Head.

Outside of work, Berkely is devoted to her family and her community. She has been married to Wayne for 32 years and has two children Tucker and Devin. She practices yoga regularly and loves to travel and spend time outdoors.

Name: Brad Morgan
Intro description: Hi there! 👋🏼 I'm Brad, a former Procter & Gamble employee turned financial advisor.  With a focus on tax planning, I've been a trusted advisor for the P&G community for over ten years.  I pride myself on building lasting relationships with my clients, understanding their needs, and providing tailored solutions. I define success as taking the client relationship to a level of complete trust and confidence.
Quote: I like getting to know my clients on a personal level. I have found that it makes for a much better professional relationship. It is important to me that every client feels like I am a phone call or text message away, be it on a Saturday morning or Wednesday afternoon.
Service description 1: Qualified experience in specifics around P&G benefits including: retirement planning and readiness analysis, stock option analysis and planning, tax efficient investing and the utilization of direct Indexing, income planning in retirement, distribution strategies from Procter’s Profit Sharing Trust Plan (PST), specifically the use of net unrealized appreciation.
Service eyebrow 2: UNDERSTAND YOUR INCOME STREAMS
Service description 2: Understand your income with an annual plan showing where cash flow is generated, and why.
Service description 3: Whether it’s transferring assets to kids or grandkids, or maximizing your charitable donations, we have the expertise with complex strategies surrounding wealth transfer.
Full description:
Brad is a CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER™ who specializes in assisting Procter & Gamble (P&G) employees and retirees with their financial planning needs. With expertise in tax strategies, charitable giving, stock options, estate planning, and income management, Brad provides tailored guidance to help clients navigate the complexities of their compensation packages. His unique perspective as a former P&G employee and a member of a multi-generational P&G family enables him to empathize with clients’ challenges and decisions. He holds both a bachelor's and a master's degree in Mechanical Engineering from the University of Tennessee, where he graduated with honors. Brad met his wife, Jenny, at P&G, where she worked in marketing for 12 years. They live in Madeira, OH, with their four children and two dogs.

Outside of work, Brad and Jenny are passionate cyclists and enjoy traveling with their family. They also love skiing—snow in winter and water in summer—and actively participate in their local church, Crossroads. This blend of personal and professional experience makes Brad a trusted resource for P&G employees seeking to secure their financial futures.
Faq answer 1: I grew up in a family of P&G Engineers which led me naturally pursue Mechanical Engineering for both my Bachelors and Masters degrees. After college I started my career at Procter & Gamble, where I worked in roles across R&D and Engineering. However, my interest in investment management and financial planning led me to a career change in 2014, where I studied for my CFP® and began working as an investment advisor at a local registered investment advisor.
Faq answer 2: With my background at P&G, the vast majority of clients I work with are current or former P&G employees. Over the years, I have also developed a niche focus on business owners, specifically, those with complex multi generational legacy planning. I enjoy becoming part of the longer term planning and partnering with the families’ attorneys and accountants.
Faq answer 3: Working with the P&G clientele, I have a deep understanding of the P&G benefits package. This includes everything from stock option planning down to healthcare related decisions. For our P&G clients, distribution at retirement brings many opportunities using net unrealized appreciation of “preferred” stock. This is another expertise, but taking it a step further putting a plan in place for income generation over the retirement years in a tax efficient manner taking into account the various buckets of assets a retiree has.
Faq answer 4: Strategies are always unique to the client, ranging from a philanthropic client who needs help with a charitable remainder trust or donor advised fund to a P&G client who needs help with distribution from their profit sharing plan. Concentrated stock is often seen with P&G retirees, and tax efficient diversification strategies using direct indexing in combination with exchange funds would be another example. Clients looking to maximize wealth transfer may find opportunities with GRATs attractive, and I am in a position to help bring light to all these various strategies and assist the client with the decision that makes sense for their family.
Faq answer 5: Hosting quarterly events, I have the opportunity to not only get to know the client but their family. My favorite part of this job is having relationships that I would otherwise not have.
Faq answer 6: In my opinion, Savvy is the future of wealth management - The approach to investments is sophisticated and research-backed. The platform is designed with the client in mind. Transitioning from Mariner Wealth Advisors to Savvy, Brad was drawn by Savvy's innovative approach to wealth management, particularly in direct indexing. His focus remains on serving Procter & Gamble employees and retirees, offering tailored financial planning with a keen focus on tax optimization.

Name: Brandon Barber
Intro description: With over 13 years of sales and consulting experience in the 401(k) and HR Technology world, I help retirement plan sponsors and employees navigate the complexities associated with retirement plans.
Service description 1: Retirement plans often contain an overwhelming number of time-sensitive tasks. We’ve helped business owners streamline their payroll and 401(k) administration processes.
Service description 2: From navigating complex audits to keeping up with U.S. codes, we help you avoid compliance complications so you can focus on running your business.
Service description 3: We worked with the nation’s leading record keepers to develop solutions that simplify the biggest 401(k) hurdles.
Full description:
Straight out of Texas State University, Brandon spent over seven years at ADP helping hundreds of business owners streamline their payroll and 401(k) administration processes. During that time, Brandon realized he wanted to revolutionize how plan sponsors and employees interact with their retirement plans.

His subsequent role at Paycor would allow him to help HR and Finance leaders identify inefficiencies and design the right solutions for employer-sponsored retirement plans. With a passion for positively impacting the financial health of those he works with, Brandon joined Savvy to help plan sponsors and employees decrease the burden of understanding and optimizing benefits.

Outside of his passion for 401(k) plans, Brandon loves spending time outdoors with his family, advocating for foster care, and finding ways to give back to his local church. He also loves to dance. So much in fact that he met his wife two-stepping in Austin!

Name: Brandon Mull
Intro description:
I’m Brandon, Founder of Marathon Wealth Advisors. I help individuals and families turn complex financial decisions into clear, confident plans built for the long run. With nearly two decades of experience in wealth management and investment strategy, and both the CFA® and CFP® designations, I bring a disciplined, thoughtful approach to every client relationship.

As a lifelong endurance athlete and two-time U.S. Olympic Trials marathon qualifier, I believe the same patience, rigor, and long-term mindset required for successful marathoning are essential to achieving lasting financial outcomes. At the core of my work is a deep respect for each client’s goals and priorities – not only in achieving financial success, but in exploring the question, “What else is possible?” – and a commitment to helping them move forward with clarity and confidence.
Quote: Financial confidence doesn’t come from reacting to the market – it comes from having a plan you understand, believe in, and can stay the course with through every season of life.
Team description: At Marathon Wealth Advisors, we provide disciplined, relationship-based advice rooted in integrity, transparency, and accountability. In an over-scaled industry, we take a more personal approach, designing bespoke portfolios that combine customized fixed income strategies with innovative, option-based solutions to help manage risk and enhance long-term outcomes. Above all, we respect that every client’s situation is unique, taking the time to listen, educate, and serve as a trusted partner so clients can move forward with clarity, confidence, and a plan built to endure.
Service eyebrow 1: TAKE CONTROL OF YOUR FINANCIAL FUTURE
Service description 1: Personalized wealth management helps our clients protect their assets. We use a holistic approach to financial planning that integrates tax strategy, trust & estate planning, and risk management.
Service eyebrow 2: STRATEGIC, DATA-DRIVEN INVESTING TO TARGET AMBITIOUS RESULTS
Service description 2: End-to-end investment management focused on tailoring portfolios to each client’s specific circumstances and preferences. Our tailored approach will take into consideration all facets of your situation along with current economic data to optimize your portfolio's risk and return.
Service description 3: Transition into your golden years with confidence. Our goal is to see to it that you’re prepared for the unpredictable. Let us turn your retirement dreams into actionable plans.
Service eyebrow 4: STRIVING TO MINIMIZE YOUR TAX BURDEN
Service description 4: We aim to take the ambiguity of tax planning by utilizing tax-reducing strategies that encompass your overall tax liability. We do it by putting together a game plan that is specific to your needs.
Full description:
Brandon Mull is Founder and Principal Wealth Advisor for Marathon Wealth Advisors. He brings nearly two decades of experience spanning wealth advisory, investment management, and derivatives trading to serve the needs of his clients. Brandon’s unique expertise lies in the powerful combination of portfolio management paired with customized financial planning which helps clients confidently address key risks such as inflation, market volatility, as well as tax and estate exposure, ensuring their wealth lasts throughout their retirement years.

Prior to founding Marathon Wealth Advisors, Brandon’s career experience included roles in equity research, as well as proprietary futures and options trading. He later was a portfolio manager at Morgan Stanley where he and his team managed and set investment strategy for high-net-worth relationships. Most recently, Brandon was a Senior Vice President at a top wealth management firm, serving as head of their Detroit office with a fourfold growth of relationships, and leading their expansion into the Chicago market.

Brandon holds a BA in Business/Economics from Wheaton College, and holds a rare combination of rigorous credentials, obtaining both the CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst) and CFP (Certified Financial Planner) designations. As a four-time collegiate All-American, Brandon eventually became an avid marathon runner, twice qualifying for the U.S. Olympic Trials (2016 and 2020). He believes that the discipline, rigor, and long-term approach required for successful marathoning are analogous to those required for successful financial outcomes and embody the spirit and purpose of Marathon Wealth Advisors.

At the core of Brandon’s work is a deep respect for each client’s individual story, goals, and priorities. He views his role as a trusted partner, helping clients make informed decisions, prepare for the unexpected, and move forward with confidence toward the life they want to build.
Faq answer 1: I began my career helping launch a registered investment advisor firm during the 2008–2009 financial crisis. While I was immediately drawn to the personal side of advising and the opportunity to help people through uncertain moments, I recognized early on that I needed broader experience before fully stepping into that role. I went on to build a strong foundation in investment management, trading, and research, before taking steps to re-enter the wealth space again with more wisdom under my belt, leveraging those experiences to create meaningful, long-term value for my clients.
Faq answer 2: I serve clients across a broad spectrum, including wealthy individuals, institutions, and endowments as well as younger high earning professionals just starting to secure their financial future. The common thread tends to be astute investors who are looking for long-term professional relationships built on trust unbiased investment counsel. Many of our clients have had experience utilizing their own self management or a sales based advisor. Therefore, my clients prioritize having a fiduciary advisor with independent expertise and advice that is free from conflicts.
Faq answer 3: My expertise centers on comprehensive financial planning designed to help clients identify and achieve their long-term goals, while also preparing for worst-case scenarios. I pair traditional planning with proactive risk management, utilizing innovative strategies to help hedge against significant, unexpected market events that could threaten long-term wealth creation. I believe this approach shifts the focus from simply accumulating assets to building sustainable, lifelong income streams. I also specialize in analyzing corporate retirement plans such as pensions, deferred compensation, , helping clients evaluate lump-sum decisions and convert them into predictable, inflation-protected sources of income.
Faq answer 4: I help clients implement strategies across every stage of their financial lives, including retirement planning, intergenerational wealth transfer, and estate maximization using tax- and risk-efficient structures. My work also includes options-based hedging strategies, institutional-quality investment portfolio construction, and detailed planning around Social Security, Medicare, college funding, and financing decisions. Ultimately, my focus is on coordinating every element that impacts a client’s financial world into a cohesive, long-term strategy.
Faq answer 5: My favorite part of working with my clients is getting to know their stories and what truly matters to them. I enjoy building real relationships and being a trusted partner as we turn their goals into a clear, actionable plan they can feel confident about.
Faq answer 6: Working with Savvy allows me to focus more of my time and energy on my clients. Their best-in-class operations and technology streamline many of the time-intensive aspects of wealth management, while their adaptable, forward-thinking culture values feedback and continuous improvement, something that’s rare on Wall Street and incredibly important to me.

Name: Brandon Wyand
Intro description:
Hi, I’m Brandon. I’m the Founder of Out West Financial and a financial advisor based in Morrison, Colorado. I help people make thoughtful financial decisions without getting distracted by market noise or the latest trend.

My approach brings together financial planning, tax considerations, estate and trust planning, and investment strategy. The numbers matter, but so do your priorities and how you feel about the choices in front of you. My role is to give you the context and perspective to make informed decisions that fit your life.
Quote: There are a hundred possible paths. My job is to help you understand your options and choose the one that makes sense for your life.
Service eyebrow 1: STRIVING TO MINIMIZE YOUR TAX BURDEN
Service description 1: We aim to take the ambiguity out of tax planning by utilizing tax-reducing strategies that encompass your overall tax liability. We do it by putting together a game plan that is specific to your needs.
Service eyebrow 2: PRESERVATION OF YOUR LEGACY
Service description 2: We specialize in making the often complex and emotionally charged process of trust and estate planning as seamless as possible ensuring the security and preservation of a client's legacy for future generations.
Service description 3: Build your own personalized index portfolio based on your unique values with direct ownership of individual stocks. This allows for greater customization and effective tax loss harvesting.
Service eyebrow 4: TAKE CONTROL OF YOUR FINANCIAL FUTURE
Service description 4: Personalized wealth management helps our clients protect their assets. We use a holistic approach to financial planning that integrates tax strategy, trust & estate planning, and risk management.
Full description:
Brandon Wyand is the Founder of Out West Financial and brings more than a decade of experience in wealth management. He earned his CFP® designation in 2018 and has held advisory roles at Compound Planning, Vanguard, Personal Capital, and Empower Advisory Group. He also obtained Series 63 and 65 licenses and graduated from Arizona State University with a degree in Business Entrepreneurship.

Entrepreneurship was part of Brandon’s life well before wealth management. He ran a successful eBay business through high school and college and purchased his first home in Old Town Scottsdale during his senior year. That entrepreneurial background continues to shape the practical, independent perspective he brings to his work today.

Now based in Morrison, Colorado, Brandon enjoys skiing, riding his Aprilia Tuono V4 1100RR, seeing live music at Red Rocks, and exploring Colorado with his wife and their three dogs.
Faq answer 1:
Mostly by chance. During my senior year at Arizona State University, my parents encouraged me to attend a career fair. I was on my way out when someone from AXA Advisors stopped me and introduced me to financial advising.

At 22, I was drawn to the entrepreneurial side of the career. I started in the life insurance industry and eventually met a mentor who was a CFP® professional. Seeing the way he approached the profession gave me a clearer picture of the kind of advisor I wanted to become. I earned my CFP® designation in 2018, and what began as an unexpected conversation at a career fair turned into my career.
Faq answer 2:
I work with people who want more freedom in their financial lives and value having someone they can talk to openly about money.

There isn’t one age or demographic that defines my clients. A retiree on the West Coast can be just as good a fit as a 28-year-old graphic designer in New York City. What matters is that we communicate well and can have direct, productive conversations about the decisions that affect their lives.
Faq answer 3:
My work centers on tax planning considerations, estate and trust planning, investment style and selection, and financial planning.

I also pay close attention to how clients experience risk. Traditional risk assessments can provide useful information, but they do not always capture how someone will react when circumstances change. Understanding that emotional component gives me another lens when helping clients evaluate financial decisions.
Faq answer 4:
The strategy depends on the person. I help clients look at the financial choices available to them, understand the tradeoffs, and determine which direction fits their circumstances.

That can involve coordinating tax considerations, estate planning, investment decisions, or broader financial planning. Instead of starting with a predetermined answer, I start with what the client is trying to accomplish.
Faq answer 5:
The people. The financial side of the work came naturally to me, but relationships are what made me want to stay in the profession.

I enjoy talking with people, learning what matters to them, and being useful when they have an important decision to make. Over time, those conversations create the kind of working relationships that make this career rewarding for me.
Faq answer 6:
Savvy gives me the autonomy to build my practice around the way I want to serve clients, while providing technology and resources that support the work behind the scenes.

I see that combination as a strong fit for where financial advice is headed and for the kind of practice I want to continue building.

My work focuses on retirement planning, tax planning, lifetime income strategies, Social Security, and estate considerations. I take a proactive approach, looking ahead for planning opportunities and coordinating with clients’ CPAs and other trusted professionals so the different parts of their financial lives work together.

Full description:
Brett Tushingham has spent more than 20 years in wealth management, helping families plan for retirement and navigate the financial decisions that come with this stage of life. He began his career on Wall Street, where he gained experience in the financial industry before deciding he wanted to work more directly with families and their financial goals.

That shift led Brett to financial advising. Since 2014, he has owned and operated a wealth management practice focused on retirement and tax planning for families nearing retirement. His work commonly addresses questions around retirement income, Social Security, taxes, and estate considerations.

Brett is a CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER™ professional and holds a BBA in Finance from Pace University. Based in Wilmington, North Carolina, he works with clients nationwide.

Faq answer 2: I primarily work with families nearing retirement who want a clear plan for the years ahead. Faq answer 4: I help clients work through questions such as when to begin Social Security, how to approach taxes throughout retirement, and how to create a lifetime income strategy. The goal is to bring these decisions together within a coordinated plan rather than treating each one separately.
Faq answer 5: Few professions allow you to have such a direct, positive impact on people’s lives. I especially enjoy guiding clients through significant transitions, including the move into retirement, and helping them work through the financial decisions that come with those changes.

I can concentrate on taking a proactive approach to retirement and tax planning, identifying issues that may need attention, and being fully present in conversations with my clients.

Intro description: Hi there! I’m Brian Jellig, a Principal Wealth Advisor from San Diego, California, specializing in retirement portfolio strategies and income planning. My passion lies in simplifying the complexities of investments, finances, and retirement for my clients. My father worked as an Estate Planning Attorney. From him and my grandfather, I learned the basics of investing and building wealth early on. After working with clients for almost ten years, I love the journey of helping them endeavor to reach financial success for their families.

Full description:
Brian Jellig, CFP®, is a Principal Wealth Advisor in San Diego, California, who endeavors to help his clients retire with confidence and clarity through comprehensive, customized retirement income planning strategies.

Growing up here in San Diego, CA, Brian spent a lot of time around his father, a local Estate Planning Attorney with a private practice, and his grandfather, a career Electrical Engineer for Kearfott. His conversations around the dinner table as a kid were on topics like the power of “compound interest over time” and the concept that “your dollars are your employees and you need to put them to work.” These laid the groundwork for a meaningful career as a financial advisor.

Brian graduated from PLNU in San Diego, CA, and spent many years working in the business world. In those working years, he always invested extra funds into a family trust portfolio he set up. He also invested in rental properties both locally and out of state.

Following the passing of both his grandparents, Brian didn’t want all the financial knowledge he had gained to go to waste. He became inspired to share his knowledge and experience to help others gain their financial independence.

As a Principal Wealth Advisor, he has worked for Edward Jones, Epstein & White, and Mercer Advisors. Today, he is excited about continuing his career and serving clients at Savvy.

My experience lies in providing personalized solutions for diversifying and safeguarding hard earned client wealth to address dynamic markets. I also offer comprehensive financial planning services, encompassing proactive tax and estate planning, to assist clients in embracing life's ebbs and flows with confidence, while optimizing their financial landscape.
Quote: I specialize in consolidating those “knights of the round table” for my clients and their assets, to make certain that my clients’ total investment, estate, tax and retirement planning are clear, dynamic, and built for success across changing markets, life circumstances, and economic conditions.
Service description 1: We actively research alternative investment opportunities and monitor your portfolio investment holdings, bringing together actionable insights and forward-thinking risk assessments.

Full description:
Brian Mills is a financial services professional with over a decade of experience, with the most recent six years being at a prominent multi-family office advisory firm. He brings the knowledge, experience, and enthusiasm required to guide investors through the complexities of proactive tax planning, estate planning, financial strategies, and diversified investment management, helping them achieve their financial goals effectively.

As a former Division 1 athlete and graduate of Princeton University's Psychology and Neuroscience department, Brian possesses a uniquely diverse range of expertise. He has repurposed his athlete-work ethic and focused approach on deeply understanding his clients, providing proactive, personalized advice in investment management and financial planning. With a keen eye on tax and estate planning, Brian, as a Wealth Manager at Savvy, merges his passion and strength in building connections with people.

Apart from serving clients, he is dedicated to giving back to his community, serving as a local Advisory Board member for CollegeTrack. This non-profit organization is committed to supporting, mentoring, and providing resources to underserved youth in local and nationwide communities. In his free time, he enjoys spending time with his girlfriend and their two dogs, and appreciates live music, traveling, sports, and art.
Faq answer 1:
My venture into financial advisory took an unconventional path. I began my career shortly after college as a wholesaler with Lincoln Financial Distributors, working specifically in their long-term care department,  focusing on long-term care solutions for financial advisors and their clients. During my four-year tenure, I came to realize the alarming rate at which medical expenses and taxes could erode a lifetime's wealth in the later stages of life, along with the emotional toll it brings. I understood that effective wealth management and financial planning implemented decades in advance could significantly alleviate this burden. Advisors providing that wealth management and planning expertise, were able to help turn those potential mountains of financial burden, into ant hills.

As a former Division 1 athlete at Princeton University for four years, I've had the privilege of closely interacting with other athletes and entrepreneurs at various career stages. This exposure has provided me with valuable insights into the challenges, successes, and unique aspirations of individuals in these realms. Across the board, one consistent truth emerged - the importance of having a trusted financial professional as a partner. Such a fiduciary is a crucial asset in safeguarding and leveraging your wealth to achieve your financial objectives effectively.

My passion for being that financial confidant, expert, and resource led me to a position at Lido Advisors, where I learned and developed experience in delivering a family-office-style experience to my clients. Our team at Lido Advisors managed 100M+ million dollars in private client assets through customized deployment of a mix of investments, including actively managed core equity and fixed income securities, alternatives, and nuanced downside protection solutions, to help protect clients’ legacies and target growth  in tactical ways.

Now, I am thrilled to be part of the Savvy team. Their investment solutions and access to diversified, alternative investments, with a proprietary, streamlined client interface, is a great home for my clients. With the help of a supportive Operations and Product Team, my clients and I have been able to lean into what matters most: Peace of mind and confidence in their investments and their financial team.
Faq answer 2:
I work with a diverse group of clients, which gives me a lot of great perspective into client lifestyles and an eclectic approach on how to manage client portfolios, investments, trusts, taxes, and retirement. Given my background as a Division I athlete, I work with athletes and entrepreneurs with non-traditional income streams and estate/tax planning needs, as well as limited liability companies (LLCs) and small business interests. I also work with individuals, preparing for, entering, and/or fully enjoying their retirement, and the nuance around those stages of life and the shift in financial goals and objectives. As I continue to work towards earning my Chartered Retirement Planning Counselor (CRPC) designation, I’ll be further credentialed in retirement planning, for clients of all ages and stages. Additionally, I work with young professionals, in the stages of earning substantial income, and at varying stages of accumulating and growing their wealth. Budgeting, asset allocation, and risk tolerance are crucial at this stage, and I help partner with clients to bridge that gap between high income, and putting those assets to work.

Last but not least, I partner with nonprofits and individuals that are philanthropically inclined. Charitable giving can be a beautiful long-time addition to clients’ lives, from both personal and financial perspectives. My expertise allows me to help identify more tax, cost, and estate planning effective ways (Donor Advised Funds, trust structure, appreciated stock, etc.) to support clients’ passions for one-time or lifetime gifts, that goes beyond cash donations.

Average clients' assets under management (AUM) range in size from $500K to $5M+; their assets no matter the amount are important to them, so they’re important to me.

This style of wealth management emulates the structure of what uber-wealthy families or endowments utilize - that being a team of investment advisors, estate attorneys, tax professionals, retirement planners, insurance, and more that work exclusively for them to ensure the protection, safety, and growth of their wealth and their generational legacies. I specialize in consolidating those “knights of the round table” for my clients and their assets, to make certain that my clients’ total investment, estate, tax, and retirement planning are clear, dynamic, and built for success across changing markets, life, and economic conditions. In addition, I offer experience in the incorporation of alternative investing, which includes debt and equity real estate-based solutions, private credit, tactical equity protection - or defined outcome - solutions, and more, to compliment their core traditional equity and fixed income exposures.
Faq answer 4:
I specialize in educating clients on implementing alternative and tactical investment strategies. This encompasses utilizing private non-correlated debt or equity real estate funds to augment or replace conventional fixed-income or equity holdings. Using these strategies can help craft portfolios that fortify against market downturns, while also diversifying away from volatile markets. This approach doesn't impede the potential for growth but rather enhances the ability to participate in market upswings.

Taking a holistic view, I specialize in creating a strong framework and unity in clients' overall financial landscapes. This involves granting access to or orchestrating discussions among associated experts in forward-thinking tax strategies, estate planning, and safeguarding legacies. By taking a proactive and thorough approach, clients can navigate common challenges related to estate tax planning, handling taxes on highly valued stocks, managing retirement income sources and Required Minimum Distributions (RMDs), optimizing charitable contributions, dealing with concentrated assets, and more.

Full description:
Bruce Larsen has been helping individuals and families pursue financial security for more than 30 years. His career began in accounting after earning a Bachelor of Science in Accounting from the University of Wyoming in 1988. After nine years in accounting, Bruce transitioned to personal financial planning, where he developed a particular expertise in retirement income, tax planning, estate planning, and Social Security.

In 2020, Bruce brought his practice to Colorado Wealth Group, where he continues to work with clients while collaborating with other advisors and professionals to provide comprehensive financial planning. His approach is highly integrated, recognizing that investment decisions, retirement income, taxes, Social Security, insurance, and estate planning are interconnected.
Bruce has a particular passion for helping clients make informed decisions about taxes in retirement. He is an Enrolled Agent (EA), giving him a strong foundation in federal taxation, and has written a book focused on taxes in retirement. He also developed Tax Acuity, a tax-planning application designed to help financial advisors identify and implement tax-planning opportunities for their clients.

For more than 25 years, Bruce has also specialized in special-needs planning, helping families address the unique financial, estate-planning, and long-term care challenges associated with disability and special-needs situations. He is a Certified Estate Planner™ (CEP®), a designation focused on estate-planning essentials including living trusts, estate taxes, disability and special-needs planning, and related topics.

Bruce's philosophy is centered on helping clients understand not just where they are financially, but how today's decisions can affect their financial security years or even generations into the future. His practice takes a multi-generational approach, working with clients and, when appropriate, helping coordinate planning across their family tree.

Bruce grew up on a cattle ranch in Wyoming and has called Colorado home since 2008. He has a grown son and daughter and enjoys spending time with family, life on his Colorado ranch, team roping, and spending time outdoors.

Full description:
Bryson Beirne is a Wealth Advisor at Savvy Wealth who works with business owners, high-earning professionals, retirees, and families navigating increasingly complex financial lives. Before joining Savvy, he spent more than a decade at a large wealth management organization advising ultra-high-net-worth families, business owners, and executives.

Born on Oʻahu, Bryson is a proud Native Hawaiian. Family and community have been important influences throughout his life and continue to shape the way he approaches his work with clients.

Bryson played Division I football at the University of Arizona, where competing at that level taught him discipline and how to perform under pressure. He graduated early and entered the MBA program at the Eller College of Management. Partway through his graduate studies, Bryson stepped away to serve a two-year mission in Alaska. He later returned to complete his MBA and begin his career in wealth management.

Over the course of his career, Bryson has seen how financial decisions can affect families across generations. Those experiences shaped his belief that planning should begin with understanding what a client wants their wealth to accomplish.

Today, Bryson helps clients bring the different parts of their financial lives into a coordinated plan. His work can include preparing business owners for an eventual exit, planning around retirement and career transitions, evaluating tax considerations over multiple years, developing charitable giving strategies, and addressing estate and legacy goals.

Bryson also works closely with clients’ CPAs, attorneys, and other professionals to coordinate decisions across their financial lives. His approach starts with the client’s family, priorities, and intended impact before moving to individual financial strategies.

Bryson and his wife, Annie, live in Denton, Texas. He is active in his church and local community, and they share a love of traveling the world.
Faq answer 1:
I played football at the University of Arizona, where competing at that level taught me discipline and how to perform under pressure. I graduated early and went directly into the MBA program at the Eller College of Management.

Partway through my graduate studies, I stepped away to serve a two-year mission in Alaska. Those two years had a significant influence on how I work with people. They taught me patience, humility, and the importance of understanding someone before trying to help them. I returned to finish my MBA and then began my career in wealth management.

Over the years, I’ve seen what can happen when wealth is managed thoughtfully and connected to a family’s goals. I’ve also seen the consequences of missed opportunities and decisions that affect multiple generations. Those experiences gave me a passion for helping families make thoughtful decisions about what they have built.

I tend to think about three priorities: family, health, and wealth. I chose to focus my career on the third so my clients can spend more of their attention on the first two.
Faq answer 2:
I work with successful business owners, high-earning professionals, retirees, and families whose finances have reached a point where piecemeal advice is no longer enough.

Many of my clients have accumulated meaningful wealth but are also dealing with greater complexity. They may be preparing to sell a business, approaching retirement, navigating a career transition, considering how to transfer assets to the next generation, or trying to coordinate financial decisions across multiple professionals.

They want someone who can see the entire picture and help connect those decisions to one clear plan.
Faq answer 3:
My work centers on bringing the different parts of a family’s financial life into one coordinated plan.

That includes comprehensive financial planning, tax planning, retirement and income planning, business-owner planning, estate and trust considerations, charitable giving, and legacy planning.

I also coordinate with clients’ CPAs, attorneys, and other professionals. The goal is to make sure the people involved understand the broader plan and that financial, tax, legal, and investment decisions are considered in relation to one another.
Faq answer 4:
I help clients align their wealth with the life they want to live today and what they want to accomplish for future generations.

For a business owner, that might mean preparing years ahead of a potential sale and considering the tax, estate, investment, and family implications together. For a high-earning professional, it might involve planning around a career transition, retirement timing, cash flow, and taxes.

I also help clients evaluate charitable giving and legacy strategies so they can think intentionally about how assets may benefit family members or causes that matter to them.

The common thread is integration. Rather than addressing each decision separately, I connect it to the broader financial plan and coordinate with the client’s other professionals when appropriate.
Faq answer 5:
My favorite part is seeing wealth fulfill a meaningful purpose in a client’s life.

Building wealth can be an important accomplishment, but I find it especially rewarding when clients begin using what they have built to support the people and causes they care about.

That might mean creating opportunities for children or grandchildren, providing greater financial security for a family, supporting a community, or giving to organizations that matter deeply to them.

Being part of the planning that helps turn those intentions into action is what makes this work fulfilling for me.
Faq answer 6:
I chose Savvy because its approach aligns with how I want to serve clients: putting people first, providing thoughtful advice, and building lasting relationships.

Savvy’s technology and operational resources also help streamline much of the work happening behind the scenes. That gives me more time to spend directly with clients, understanding their goals, coordinating with the other professionals in their lives, and helping them care for what they have built.

For me, that means keeping more of my attention where I believe it belongs: on clients and their families.

I work primarily with high-earning professionals, executives, and families navigating concentrated equity, IPO liquidity events, tax considerations, real estate, and other complex financial decisions.

My background in institutional portfolio construction and research shapes how I approach planning today. I bring investments, taxes, cash flow, risk management, and long-term goals into one coordinated picture, with the aim of helping clients use their wealth to create more flexibility in how they work, spend their time, and plan for the future.
