Kurt Fetter has spent more than 20 years helping business owners, investors, and families navigate important financial decisions. His career began with a focus on estate planning for successful farming families. While he enjoyed that work, he became increasingly interested in investment management and wanted to play a larger role in helping clients build and manage their wealth. That interest led him into the advisory industry, where he discovered a passion for building personalized investment strategies and helping clients work toward their long-term goals.

Today, Kurt focuses on serving family-owned businesses, business owners, and investors who are looking for personalized guidance around investments, retirement planning, and long-term financial goals. Many of his clients are preparing for significant life transitions, including retirement or the eventual sale of their business. His background includes investment management, stock selection, tax-aware planning, alternative investments, and business succession planning. He also has considerable experience helping business owners prepare for ownership transitions and business sales.

Kurt particularly enjoys helping business owners navigate both their company and personal financial lives, creating strategies that support their goals before, during, and after retirement. He helps clients build investment portfolios designed to support retirement goals while considering tax implications and long-term objectives. For business owners, he often assists with preparing a business for sale, organizing financial records, evaluating opportunities, and navigating the transition process from ownership to retirement.

For Kurt, the relationships are the most rewarding part of the work. He enjoys getting to know clients, learning about their families, businesses, and goals, and being part of important decisions throughout their lives. Over time, many client relationships grow beyond the professional level, which is one of the most gratifying aspects of what he does. Kurt holds an MBA and is based in New York, NY.

Full description:
Lee Levy brings over 15 years of experience in the alternative investment space, where he worked closely with hedge funds, investment banks, and institutional clients as a trader and fund manager. His rules-based investment strategy was built to remove emotion from decision-making — an approach he continues to bring into his work as a wealth manager today. Based in Alamo, CA, Lee works with high-net-worth individuals who want long-term financial clarity without unnecessary risk, helping them align their portfolios with their goals, values, and the realities of the market.

Lee’s favorite part of his work is seeking ways to help clients shed financial stress, empowering them to focus on what truly matters in life.
Faq answer 1:
I spent over 15 years as a trader in the alternatives space — working with hedge funds, investment banks, and institutional clients. Along the way, I developed and ran my own fund built around a rules-based investment strategy designed to remove emotion from decision-making.The shift toward financial advisory began when clients started asking, “I like what you do with my investments — what should I do with the rest of my money?” At the same time, friends and family often asked me for advisor recommendations. And frankly, I struggled to find anyone I felt confident referring them to.

My criteria were simple — but rarely met:

Put clients’ interests first

Offer thoughtful, personalized guidance (not a one-size-fits-all model)

Truly understand investments, volatility, and risks — not just repeat headlines from CNBC

After working with hundreds of advisors during my time on trading desks, I found very few who weren’t more focused on sales than service. So I eventually decided to endeavor to become the advisor I felt was missing from the industry.

Name: Lindsey K. Leaverton
Intro description: Hey y'all! I'm Lindsey - a Private Wealth Advisor who believes peace of mind isn't found in projections; it's built through partnership. I help clients turn financial complexity into clarity, designing personalized roadmaps that lead to real, sustainable freedom. I'm especially passionate about working with dynamic women ready to reclaim their financial power (or claim it for the very first time). My work blends the analytical and the intuitive: a neurodivergent, creative brain that sees patterns differently and an obsessive attention to detail that ensures nothing slips through the cracks. My approach is holistic and human, rooted in empathy, education, and collaboration. Because the best plans aren't built for you... they're built with you. After all, time is our greatest asset, and money's just the tool that buys us back the moments that matter.
Quote: Money matters, but it’s just the tool. The real goal is helping people spend their time the way they want, with purpose and presence. And honestly, I love the collaboration, building the blueprint together and walking the path side by side. That’s where the real magic happens.
Service eyebrow 1: STRIVING TO MINIMIZE YOUR TAX BURDEN
Service description 1: We aim to take the ambiguity out of tax planning by utilizing tax-reducing strategies that encompass your overall tax liability. We do it by putting together a game plan that is specific to your needs.
Service eyebrow 2: TAKE CONTROL OF YOUR FINANCIAL FUTURE
Service description 2: Personalized wealth management helps our clients protect their assets. We use a holistic approach to financial planning that integrates tax strategy, trust & estate planning, and risk management.
Service description 3: Empower women by breaking down the barriers they face in managing their finances, and help them take control of their financial futures.
Service description 4: We help clients make informed decisions around stock options, RSUs, ESPPs, and other equity awards. Our approach integrates tax planning, diversification strategies, and long-term wealth planning to help you manage concentration risk and align your equity compensation with your broader financial goals.
Full description:
Lindsey K. Leaverton is an Austin-based Private Wealth Advisor at Savvy Wealth, specializing in financial planning and investment management for individuals and families who want to align their wealth with their values.

A proud Texan and Texas A&M magna cum laude graduate, Lindsey began her career leading a nonprofit as Executive Director while touring the country as a professional recording artist and speaker. Her passion for servant leadership led her to the financial services industry in 2010 where she quickly advanced from Personal Banker to Branch Manager and eventually helped launch Austin's first Private Bank for BB&T. There, she earned the National Sterling Award for excellence in leadership and client service.

Before joining Savvy Wealth, Lindsey served as Director of Wealth Management at a $1B Austin advisory firm, where she led client strategy and designed comprehensive financial plans for high-net-worth families.Recognized with the Austin Under 40 Award for Excellence in Financial Services and selected as a McBee Fellow with AARO, Lindsey also serves as Vice President of the Board for People's Community Clinic.

At Savvy, she helps clients find clarity and confidence through thoughtful financial planning, values-aligned investing, and tax-efficient strategies. She holds FINRA Series 7, 63, and 66 licenses, along with the AWMA® designation.

Outside of work, Lindsey lives in Cedar Park, TX with her twin teenagers and two rescue pups. Featured in outlets such as The New York Times and People Magazine, she's also an author, speaker, and singer. Her debut book, Not Another Self-Help Book, became as Amazon Bestseller in 2024. A lifelong creative, Lindsey believes that laughter - like money - is best when shared.
Faq answer 1: The story of how I found myself in financial services is best told over drinks (bourbon, preferably). The short version? I was recruited. Fifteen years ago, while waiting tables at a seafood restaurant, a banking executive sat in my section and somehow convinced me to come work with her. Saying yes to that one table was one of the best decisions I’ve ever made.
Faq answer 2: I specialize in financial planning and asset management for independent women who are ready to take their financial power back or claim it for the first time. I also love working with high-income couples, usually parents, who want clarity, confidence, and a trusted partner to help simplify their financial lives. My clients include entrepreneurs, business owners, and C-suite executives navigating complex compensation structures and equity packages, people who want their money strategy to finally match the life they’re building. While I currently serve a diverse group of clients, my focus at Savvy Wealth is becoming even more intentional, centering my practice around those who want to build wealth on purpose. Most of my clients are in their forties and fifties, looking for someone they can collaborate with and confidently delegate to. My favorite clients are the curious ones, the ones who ask questions, want to learn, and value education as much as outcomes.
Faq answer 3: My expertise spans tax strategy, asset allocation, equity compensation, retirement income planning, and holistic financial planning, with specialized experience serving dynamic women, the LGBTQ+ community, and neurodivergent individuals. I also guide business owners through succession and exit planning, including post-sale strategies that align wealth with purpose and passion. My work integrates trust and estate planning, legacy strategies, and philanthropic giving, leveraging tools like donor-advised funds to maximize both impact and tax efficiency. Additional areas of focus include education planning, employer benefit optimization, and investment analysis to ensure every dollar is working toward my clients’ goals. All of my services are delivered through a values-based, holistic approach designed to create clarity, confidence, and long-term peace of mind.
Faq answer 4: I design and implement comprehensive financial strategies that align with each client’s goals, values, and lifestyle. My work focuses on tax-efficient investing, retirement planning, equity compensation, and trust and estate integration, ensuring every part of a financial plan works together so we’re all reading from the same sheet of music. I also guide clients through business exit and liquidity event planning, helping them navigate major transitions with clarity and confidence. Other strategies often include tax bracket management, philanthropic giving, and diversified investment approaches, including access to alternative investments such as private credit and private equity. Above all, my focus is holistic planning, keeping clients on track, informed, and supported as their plans evolve. Because at the end of the day, a plan is only as good as the person who walks it with you.
Faq answer 5: I live for the ah-ha moment when everything clicks and a client realizes, “Oh… this is working.” It’s the deep breath, the shoulders dropping, that quiet shift from pressure to peace. That’s when I know the plan we’ve built together is doing its job, creating freedom, flexibility, and confidence. Money matters, but it’s just the tool. The real goal is helping people spend their time the way they want, with purpose and presence. And honestly, I love the collaboration, building the blueprint together and walking the path side by side. That’s where the real magic happens.
Faq answer 6: What I value most about Savvy is the freedom and flexibility to show up as the kind of advisor my clients truly deserve, the mom my kids need, and the human I want to be. After years of being buried under admin tasks, paperwork, and chaotic minutia that pulled me away from what actually matters, my clients, Savvy gives me the space to focus on the work that lights me up: helping folks feel good about where they are financially and where they're headed. The platform empowers me to deliver advice with total independence, transparency, and authenticity, without the noise or archaic tech of traditional firms. It's also allowed me to create a genuine work-life blend, so I can be fully present as both an advisor and a mom to my twin teenagers. That balance - between purpose and presence - is everything to me.

Louis is dedicated to helping his clients solve the financial puzzle of their lives. He focuses on long-term planning and comprehensive wealth management for attorneys, business executives, retirees, and trustees. Louis incorporates the lessons of behavioral finance into his work. I came to the U.S. from the Dominican Republic at age 11. As an immigrant, I had to learn two languages: English, and money — and there was no one at home who could teach me the second one.

That's exactly why I do this work today. Most of the Latino executives I work with are also the first in their family to reach this level — the first to navigate equity comp, the first with a real estate portfolio, the first making decisions with no blueprint to follow. I know that experience firsthand, and I bring real technical depth to match it.

My parents instilled hard work and education as the path forward, and I've built my practice around that same belief — except now, "success" isn't just the goal. It's the starting point we build a strategy from.

Name: Matt Versage
Intro description:
Hi, I’m Matt. I’m a financial advisor in Tampa, Florida. I work with high-net-worth families and business owners on retirement, investment strategy, and long-term wealth planning.

Most of my clients come to me with several financial decisions in motion at once and no single place where those decisions connect. That is the work I do: envisioning how all the pieces fit together, building one coordinated plan, and then executing on it.
Quote: Nothing about working with me should feel like a sales process. My job is to understand what you are trying to accomplish, lay out the considerations clearly, and help you decide, not to show up with the recommendation already made.
Service description 1: Transition into your golden years with confidence. Our goal is to see to it that you’re prepared for the unpredictable. Let us turn your retirement dreams into actionable plans.
Service eyebrow 2: STRATEGIC, DATA-DRIVEN INVESTING TO TARGET AMBITIOUS RESULTS
Service description 2: End-to-end investment management focused on tailoring portfolios to each client’s specific circumstances and preferences. Our holistic approach will take into consideration all facets of your situation along with current economic data to optimize your portfolio’s risk and return.
Service description 3: We actively research alternative investment opportunities and monitor your portfolio investment holdings, bringing together actionable insights and forward-thinking risk assessments.
Service description 4: Building a successful business is an incredible feat, but what happens to your hard-earned legacy when you’re ready to step down? We build strategic blueprints to help ensure the continued growth and success of your enterprise.
Full description:
Matt Versage’s interest in wealth management  began when he watched someone close to him leave a large bank to build an independent practice. What stood out was not the business decision. It was how differently the client conversations went once an institution was not setting the agenda.
That shaped how he practices today. Matt maps the full financial picture before proposing anything: what is owned, where it sits, how it is taxed, and who it eventually passes to. Plans built before that work tend to solve for one account instead of the whole household.

As a CFP® professional, he brings a planning framework to conversations that often start as investment questions. How something should be invested usually depends on factors that have nothing to do with the portfolio.

Much of his work involves decisions that touch more than one person. A business owner weighing a sale. Parents coordinating with adult children. Assets spread across accounts and entities with different tax treatment. His role is to hold those pieces in view at the same time, so a choice that looks right on its own does not create a problem somewhere else.
Faq answer 1: Someone in my family left a large bank to start their own practice, and I had a front-row seat to it. Before that I did not really know this was a career you could build on your own terms. Watching them do it made the work look like what it actually is: helping people think clearly about decisions that matter to them.
Faq answer 2: High-net-worth families and business owners, usually at a point where things have gotten complicated. Someone approaching a liquidity event. A family whose assets sit across multiple households and account types. People moving from earning to drawing down. The common thread is having several good options and no clear way to compare them.
Faq answer 3: Retirement planning and multigenerational wealth planning are the core. Around that, investment management and asset allocation, and the coordination work of getting financial decisions to line up across a household or family.
Faq answer 4: A lot of it is sequencing and location: which account a decision happens in, in what order, and what that means for taxes now versus later. Asset allocation gets looked at across every account a family holds, not one at a time. No recommendation makes sense outside the context of the client’s broader financial picture.
Faq answer 5: The shift that happens when someone stops carrying their finances around as a vague worry. They arrive with a pile of accounts and open questions, and at some point it turns into something they can actually see and talk about. That is the part I like.
Faq answer 6: Savvy is built around the advisor experience and has a real understanding of what advisors need to serve their clients. I appreciate the company’s willingness to rethink existing processes and make changes that can support better experiences for both advisors and clients.

Full description:
Matthew Finley, CFP®, a Wealth Manager from Minneapolis, MN, specializes in active investment management, tax planning, and income planning for retirement.

The inspiration for his career in the financial industry came from conversations with his grandfather as a young boy. While these discussions about the stock market planted a seed in Matthew, he started off his professional career as a research microbiologist working on the antimicrobial properties of chemicals in the health and food safety industries. During this time, Matthew worked on numerous well-known products in the marketplace and has four patents. After his science career, Matthew moved into the sales and finance field, working for one of the largest credit processing companies in the country while developing numerous business relationships in the Midwest region.

With a strong desire to help people financially, Matthew began his financial career in 2009 with a large broker-dealer in Minneapolis, MN, where he learned the breadth of the financial markets and financial planning principles through an extensive training and research curriculum. In 2013, Matthew moved to the independent financial advisor model to better serve his clients as a fiduciary and become an expert in financial planning and asset management. In 2018, Matthew Finley joined the Perspective 6 Wealth Advisors team as a Partner & Financial Advisor to continue his pursuit of financial planning and asset management while collaborating with a highly successful team.

Beyond the world of finance, Matthew is passionate about spending time with his family, including his three children. He is actively coaching traveling baseball and acts as a part-time caddie for his daughter’s burgeoning golf career. When his time is not consumed with sports activities, he enjoys traveling to warm sandy destinations with his wife, Julie.

Faq answer 4:
When it comes to planning for retirement, my approach varies based on the individual's proximity to retirement. For those in their 20s and 30s, the emphasis is on aggressive growth since time is on their side. However, it's crucial to balance this by avoiding the pitfall of being "retirement rich" and struggling day-to-day, considering that most assets can't be accessed until after 59 and a half.

In their 40s, the strategy maintains a balance, leaning slightly towards ensuring that their retirement assets are robust and ready when needed. As clients enter their 50s or 60s, a more conservative approach is adopted. This stage involves preserving, growing, and generating income. The focus shifts from aggressive growth to maintaining a stable financial foundation while still incorporating some equity exposure to outpace inflation.

When it comes to wealth generation, many individuals use model portfolios, funds, and similar instruments. My approach involves a diversified mix, incorporating mutual funds, alternative investments such as real estate investment trusts, and blue-chip stocks. While mutual funds and alternative investments may offer stability over the long term, integrating quality stocks introduces the potential for higher returns. However, the addition of stocks requires careful selection, seeking blue-chip stocks with the worst-case scenario being a flat performance while continuing to generate dividends.

Establishing relationships with clients allows me to gain a profound understanding of their lives, personalities, habits, and routines.

The goal is to design financial plans that not only cater to their requirements but also helps to  ensure peace of mind. For clients with a higher risk tolerance, I understand that it doesn't necessitate taking excessive risks. If a modest rate of return can meet their goals, exceeding that becomes an added bonus. Striking this balance helps to ensure that clients feel secure in their financial decisions without losing sleep at night.

Name: Mike Smith
Intro description: Hi! I’m Mike Smith, a Wealth Manager and Certified Exit Planning Advisor (CEPA®) passionate about helping families build wealth. A retired Army National Guard officer with 20+ years of service and 25+ years in the financial industry, I built my firm, FLEX Wealth Management, on the values I’ve carried through both careers: selfless service, doing the right thing at all times, and treating every client like family. FLEX stands for Family, Legacy, and EXperience — the pillars I use to help pre-retirees and business owners protect what they’ve built and leave the legacy they want. I prioritize diversification across portfolios and income streams, and I’m a firm believer in consistent, honest communication through the good times and the hard ones.
Quote: When we bring on a new client, we say ‘welcome to the family’ — and we mean it. As a retired Army officer and a Christian, service is simply in my nature. I stay in close communication with my clients so they’re never in the dark, and I’m there for them through the tough times as well as the good.
Team description: FLEX Wealth Management is the practice we built over nearly three decades in this business. The name is a promise about how every client is served — and it comes straight from Mike’s story as a financial advisor and a retired Army officer.
Service eyebrow 1: TAKE CONTROL OF YOUR FINANCIAL FUTURE
Service description 1: Personalized wealth management helps our clients protect their assets. We use a holistic approach to financial planning that integrates tax strategy, trust & estate planning, and risk management.
Service eyebrow 2: ESTABLISH YOUR BUSINESS SUCCESSION PLAN
Service description 2: Building a successful business is an incredible feat, but what happens to your hard-earned legacy when you're ready to step down? We build strategic blueprints to help ensure the continued growth and success of your enterprise.
Service description 3: Transition into your golden years with confidence. Our goal is to see to it that you’re prepared for the unpredictable. Let us turn your retirement dreams into actionable plans.
Lead magnet copy: This guide will walk you through three essential financial considerations every business owner should address, spanning valuing your business, implementing retirement plans, and planning your eventual transition.
Full description:
Mike Smith, CEPA® is a Wealth Manager and Certified Exit Planning Advisor (CEPA®) specializing in financial, retirement income, and business succession planning. Service has defined his life on two fronts: over 20 years in the Army National Guard, from which he retired as an officer, and over 25 years guiding families through their financial lives.

Mike had an unconventional start. After college he joined an office furniture company, where he learned how a small business actually runs — sales, customer service, purchasing, and managing people. That experience gave him the itch to build and run something of his own, and a long-standing interest in investing led him to become a financial advisor in 1997.

After two decades advising clients, he founded his own firm, FLEX Wealth Management. Shaped by his faith and his military service, FLEX stands for Family, Legacy, and EXperience.

Mike is deeply rooted in his community — he has been an active member of BNI for most of his career and is involved with charities including the Ronald McDonald House and the Leukemia & Lymphoma Society.

Intro description: Hi there 👋🏼, I’m Nate and I primarily work with Procter & Gamble employees, retirees, and their families. I prioritize staying informed on all benefits for P&G employees to offer up-to-date and relevant advice. With a goals-first and consultative approach, I aim to provide tailored financial plans for each client and their families, focusing on genuine help over sales pitches.
Quote: I am not a fan of empty promises and sales pitches - my goal is to simply show individuals what I can and will do for them, and at minimum, leave them in a better place than when we first spoke.
Service description 1: Qualified experience in specifics around P&G benefits including: retirement planning and readiness analysis, stock option analysis and planning, tax efficient investing and the utilization of direct Indexing, income planning in retirement, distribution strategies from Procter’s Profit Sharing Trust Plan (PST), specifically the use of net unrealized appreciation.
Service eyebrow 2: UNDERSTAND YOUR INCOME STREAMS

Full description:
Nate is a Certified Financial Planner® and Wealth Advisor with nearly a decade of industry experience. His introduction to the world of financial advice began early in college at the University of Cincinnati through internships, where he discovered his passion and desire to work with families to achieve the retirements that they have worked so hard for.

Throughout his career, he has had the opportunity to work with many employees from Procter & Gamble, and have developed expertise helping clients with distribution strategies, options analysis & planning, and income planning in retirement.

Nate lives in Cincinnati in the Hyde Park area with his wife, Abby. In his time away from work, he enjoys running, cycling, tennis, and cheering on the Cincinnati sports teams.
Faq answer 1: During my time at the University of Cincinnati, I pursued a Finance major and was introduced to the College of Business's cooperative education program (co-op). This program allowed students to gain practical experience through internships every other semester starting from sophomore year. Serendipitously, I landed an internship with a local registered investment advisor and discovered my passion for every facet of the business, particularly the client-facing aspect. One memorable day during my internship was when the advisor I was shadowing had left the office to meet with a long-time client who had recently become widowed. The client simply needed assistance in purchasing a new car, yet the advisor dedicated the afternoon at the dealership, ensuring she made a fair deal. Witnessing the profound impact good advisors have on their clients, I knew then that there was no other path I could envision for my career. Immediately post-graduation, I embarked on a support advisor role, eager to immerse myself in this fulfilling profession.
Faq answer 2:
The vast majority of the clients that I partner with are current or former employees of Procter & Gamble. There are a lot of nuances within the P&G retirement plans, compensation packages, and retirement packages that enable a specialization in a niche like this. Additionally, Cincinnati is of course HQ to P&G.

I also enjoy extending my services to the entire household of my clients. It can be challenging for young professionals with limited assets to receive impartial advice, so I am happy to engage in conversations with my clients’ adult children as they go through phases of growing up: First jobs, 401(k)’s, Roth IRAs, to-do’s when getting married and having kids, etc. My goal is to assist them in making informed decisions to achieve their goals.
Faq answer 3:

- Stock option analysis and planning
- Tax efficient investing and the utilization of direct indexing
- Income planning in retirement
- Distribution strategies from retirement plans, specifically the use of net unrealized appreciation
Faq answer 4:
Income planning - a core tenant of every client’s financial plan, is an annual plan in retirement showing where cash flow is generated, and why. This often weaves together things such as Restricted Stock Units (RSU) flows, stock option exercises, long-term capital gains, Roth conversions, etc.

Name: Nate Parker
Intro description:
Hi, I’m Nate. I’m an Associate Wealth Advisor with Rik Saylor Financial, where I help families and individuals work through investment planning, retirement strategy, and the financial decisions that come with life transitions.

I tend to bring a steady, analytical approach to planning. I like digging into the details, but I also believe financial guidance needs to be understandable and personal. My goal is to help clients see how the pieces fit together so they can make informed decisions based on their circumstances and what matters to them.
Quote: I take the time to understand the details, explain the choices in front of you, and help connect each decision to the bigger financial picture.
Team description:
Rik Saylor Financial, or RSF, is based at 1241 Nilles Road in Fairfield, Ohio. The practice works with individuals, business owners, and families across four interconnected areas: Strategy & Execution, Tax Optimization, Protection, and Legacy Impact.

The RSF philosophy is simple: smart strategies to make, keep, and use your wealth at a fair price. The team emphasizes straight talk, clear decisions, coordinated planning, and follow-through. RSF also works collaboratively with clients’ CPAs, attorneys, insurance professionals, and other outside professionals when appropriate.

For those considering whether their current financial approach still fits their needs, RSF offers a complimentary, no-fee, zero-obligation second opinion.
Service eyebrow 1: STRATEGIC, DATA-DRIVEN INVESTING TO TARGET AMBITIOUS RESULTS
Service description 1: End-to-end investment management focused on tailoring portfolios to each client’s specific circumstances and preferences. Our holistic approach will take into consideration all facets of your situation along with current economic data to optimize your portfolio's risk and return.
Service eyebrow 2: DREAMS INTO ACTIONABLE PLANS
Service description 2: Transition into your golden years with confidence. Our goal is to see to it that you’re prepared for the unpredictable. Let us turn your retirement dreams into actionable plans.
Service eyebrow 3: TAKE CONTROL OF YOUR FINANCIAL FUTURE
Service description 3: Personalized wealth management helps our clients protect their assets. We use a holistic approach to financial planning that integrates tax strategy, trust & estate planning, and risk management.
Service description 4: We specialize in making the often complex and emotionally charged process of trust and estate planning as seamless as possible ensuring the security and preservation of a client's legacy for future generations.
Full description:
Nate Parker joined Rik Saylor Financial in July 2016 and has grown into an important member of the advisory team. His work focuses on helping families and individuals navigate investment planning, retirement strategy, and financial decisions surrounding life transitions.

Nate earned his degree in Business Economics from the University of Cincinnati and obtained his Series 65 in 2023. He combines an analytical mindset with a calm, personable communication style. He is intentional about understanding the details of a financial decision rather than rushing to an answer, and he works to make those details understandable in the context of a client’s broader plan.

For Nate, strategy and service go together. He values meaningful client relationships and approaches his work with an emphasis on being genuine, intentional, and dependable.

Outside of the office, Nate enjoys spending time with his wife, Mollie, their two daughters, and their Husky, Kiana. He is a UC basketball season-ticket holder, attends Broadway in Cincinnati, and enjoys music and time with his family.

Hi, I'm Nicole.

I'm the founder of Money Maven Financial, where I help people, especially women, bring clarity and organization to their financial lives. I believe financial planning should feel approachable, thoughtful, and connected to the realities of everyday life.

Whether you're navigating a major life transition, planning for retirement, thinking about charitable giving, or simply trying to make sense of your financial picture, my goal is to help you understand your options and make informed decisions with confidence. I take time to get to know each client so together we can build strategies that align with your values, your goals, and the life you want to create.
Quote: I help people organize their financial lives so they can make confident decisions that reflect what matters most to them, without shame or intimidation.
Team description:
Money Maven Financial was created to make financial planning feel more approachable, organized, and empowering.

The practice was built around the belief that financial decisions are deeply personal and that everyone deserves guidance without judgment or intimidation. Money Maven Financial places a strong emphasis on helping clients understand their finances, connect their money to their values, and build systems that make managing money feel more manageable.

Full description:
Nicole Burdick is the founder of Money Maven Financial and a financial advisor with more than a decade of experience helping clients organize their financial lives and make thoughtful financial decisions.

Her path into financial planning began long before she entered the industry professionally. In her early twenties, she volunteered as a financial literacy instructor and budget coach, discovering a passion for helping people build confidence around money. Before becoming a financial advisor, Nicole worked in real estate and later built a professional organizing business. Those experiences continue to influence how she works today. While she once helped people organize their homes, she now helps them organize their financial lives with the same thoughtful and practical approach.

Nicole advises clients on financial planning, investment management, retirement planning, tax-aware strategies, insurance, debt management, Social Security, and estate planning. She has a particular interest in legacy and charitable planning, helping clients create giving strategies that reflect their values while considering tax and estate planning opportunities.

She especially enjoys supporting clients through significant life transitions, including divorce, the loss of a spouse, inheritances, caregiving responsibilities, career changes, and becoming the primary financial decision-maker.

Nicole is also the author of The Money Maven Manual, where she combines practical education with visual tools that make financial concepts easier to understand. She is currently pursuing graduate studies in financial therapy and looks forward to incorporating those principles into her work with clients.

Based in Bellingham, Washington, Nicole works with clients across the country.

Full description:
Patrick Traverse is a Wealth Advisor with over a decade of experience working with entrepreneurs and business owners across the United States. His work centers on helping clients coordinate their business finances with their personal financial lives so they can make more intentional decisions about their money.

Patrick’s journey into financial planning began during his career as a professional hockey player. Early in his career, he realized he needed financial guidance that addressed more than investments. He wanted help understanding cash flow, taxes, and long-term planning decisions that influence how wealth is built over time. When he struggled to find that kind of guidance, he began learning these areas himself.

That experience shaped his perspective and ultimately led him into financial advising. Today, Patrick focuses on helping business owners build structured financial strategies that support both their personal goals and the growth of their businesses.

Patrick holds the CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER® (CFP®) designation, is an Enrolled Agent (EA) authorized to represent clients before the IRS, and holds the Certified Exit Planning Advisor (CEPA™) designation. These credentials support his work helping entrepreneurs plan for long-term financial growth, tax efficiency, and eventual business transitions.

Intro description: I'm Rahul Sarin, a financial advisor based in New York, New York. For more than two decades, I've worked with high-net-worth individuals, pre-retirees, and business owners to build wealth and create financial plans designed around their specific goals. My focus is on retirement planning, investment management, and tax-efficient strategies to help you optimize your financial picture. In addition, having lived and worked across India, the UK, and the US, I bring a cross-border perspective to helping clients build, manage, and transfer their wealth.
Quote: I combine quantitative analysis with a deep understanding of each client's personal situation to create truly tailored financial plans.
Service description 1: Transition into your golden years with confidence. Our goal is to see to it that you're prepared for the unpredictable. Let us turn your retirement dreams into actionable plans.

Service eyebrow 3: STRIVING TO MINIMIZE YOUR TAX BURDEN
Service description 3: We aim to take the ambiguity out of tax planning by utilizing tax-reducing strategies that encompass your overall tax liability. We do it by putting together a game plan that is specific to your needs.

Full description:
Rahul Sarin is a financial advisor with more than two decades of experience advising families, entrepreneurs, senior executives, and business owners across global markets.

Rahul founded Risa Wealth LLC with the purpose of helping clients create financial prosperity with clarity, confidence, and peace of mind. Before founding Risa Wealth LLC, Rahul spent 13 years at Avendus Capital, where he was a founding member of its private wealth management business. Earlier in his career, he worked with Citibank's Non-Resident Indian Wealth Management business and also held roles at Merrill Lynch and Deutsche Bank. Over the course of his career, Rahul has worked extensively with Indian-origin individuals and families, helping them build, preserve, and manage their wealth.

Having lived and worked in India, the United Kingdom, and the United States, Rahul brings an international wealth perspective that is especially relevant for Indian American families with personal, financial, and family interests in both the U.S. and India.

Rahul earned his undergraduate degree from St. Stephen's College, Delhi, and his MBA from SP Jain Institute of Management & Research, Mumbai. He also completed the Senior Executive Leadership Program at Harvard Business School.

Rahul lives in New York with his wife and son, who is pursuing his undergraduate studies at the University of Chicago. Outside of work, Rahul's interests include yoga, meditation, and spending time with his family.
Faq answer 1:
I have always been interested in the deeper role money plays in people's lives. Growing up in a middle-income household in India, I saw how money can influence one's sense of security, opportunity, and family responsibility.

My curiosity grew during my MBA as I developed an interest in the financial markets and the power of long-term compounding. After graduation I began my career with Citibank working with Indian families outside India. Early in my career Citibank relocated me to Manchester in the United Kingdom to help build its NRI Wealth Management presence in the area from the ground up.

Working across India, the U.K., and now the U.S. has shaped my perspective as an advisor. While each country has its own financial systems, regulations, and unique opportunities, the needs of families are often very similar. People want to protect their wealth, care for their loved ones, and feel comfortable about the future.

This realization sits at the core of why I founded Risa Wealth LLC. My goal is to help clients bring structure and clarity to their financial lives, so that they can feel confident about the life and legacy they are creating.
Faq answer 2:
I primarily work with global Indian families, especially Indian Americans who have built meaningful wealth. My clients include senior executives, technology founders, entrepreneurs, business owners, and other professionals.

Many of the families I work with have created successful lives in the U.S. while continuing to maintain deep family, financial, and emotional ties to India. They may have U.S.-based investments, equity compensation, business interests, real estate, legacy goals, or philanthropic interests across both countries.

These clients need careful coordination of their assets, and benefit from sophisticated U.S. wealth management paired with a deep understanding of India and its cultural nuances.
Faq answer 3: My expertise includes holistic wealth management, portfolio construction, tax-aware investment strategies, retirement planning, estate and trust coordination, concentrated stock and liquidity planning, QSBS considerations, and India-focused diversification strategies.
Faq answer 4:
I believe psychology is at the core of wealth management. Every client has a unique relationship with money that has been shaped by their life experiences, goals, risk appetite, and responsibilities. Before recommending a strategy, my role is to listen closely and deeply understand what purpose wealth is meant to accomplish in that client's life.

From there, I help clients build coordinated strategies that align their investments, planning decisions, and family priorities into a thoughtful wealth plan. For Indian American families, this often means helping them think about their U.S. and India assets together in one integrated strategy.
Faq answer 5:
My favorite part of this work is the opportunity to serve clients in a deeply personal way. Wealth management is a relationship built on trust, listening, and long-term partnership.

I enjoy helping clients bring order to the complexity of their financial situations and feel more at peace about their financial future. Each family comes with their own unique story and different pieces of their financial lives. Helping bring those pieces together into a clear plan is genuinely meaningful to me.

The most rewarding feeling for me is when a client feels they have a clear path forward, their family is well cared for, and their wealth is aligned with their aspirations. To me, that sense of clarity, confidence, and peace of mind is the most important outcome of good advice.
Faq answer 6:
What I appreciate about Savvy is that it gives me the ability to combine the personal, relationship-focused nature of my advisory practice with the strength of a modern wealth management platform.

Savvy provides the technology, operational support, and back-end resources that allow me to spend more of my time where it matters most, with clients. I also value that Savvy's platform helps create a more seamless experience for clients. By bringing planning, investment management, reporting, and collaboration together in a more organized way, it supports the personal and proactive advisory relationships I want to build with the backing of strong technology and resources.

The RSF philosophy is simple: smart strategies to make, keep, and use your wealth at a fair price. The team emphasizes straight talk, clear decisions, coordinated planning, and follow-through. RSF also works collaboratively with clients’ CPAs, attorneys, insurance professionals, and other outside professionals when appropriate.

Rik Saylor started Rik Saylor Financial in 1996 and has built his career around helping families and business owners address the interconnected decisions involved in growing, using, and transferring wealth. With 43 years of wealth management experience, he takes a holistic approach that combines financial strategy with execution.

Listening comes first. Rik believes understanding a client’s circumstances, priorities, family, and business interests is essential before deciding what should happen next. His planning process can involve investment management, tax considerations, protection planning, estate and trust planning, and succession planning. For business owners, his CEPA designation also informs his work around exit and succession considerations.

Collaboration is another important part of Rik’s approach. RSF works alongside CPAs, insurance professionals, attorneys, and other professionals to help coordinate the different pieces of a client’s financial life.

Rik holds the Series 66 as well as life, health, and annuity insurance licenses and the Certified Exit Planning Advisor designation. He has supported organizations including Hospice, the Joe Nuxhall Character Education Fund/Miracle Fields, the Yellow Ribbon Program, and Wounded Warriors. He was named Fairfield Chamber of Commerce Business Person of the Year in 2010 and spent five years volunteering as an OLLI instructor at the University of Cincinnati and University of Dayton. He is also the former host of “Straight Talk-Clear Decisions.”

Away from work, Rik and his wife, Kim, are part of a blended family with five children and five grandchildren. He enjoys pickleball, golf, biking, motorcycling, boating, and bringing family and friends together at their lake house.

Full description:
Ryan Austin is a CFP® professional and founder of Green Heron Wealthways, based in Syracuse, Indiana. His path into financial services began after graduating magna cum laude from Huntington University in 2012, where he studied philosophy and theology.

Growing up in Grand Rapids, Michigan, Ryan learned about hard work and service firsthand. His father became a general contractor while Ryan was in middle school, and Ryan spent years working alongside him. That experience gave Ryan an early appreciation for the responsibility that comes with running a business and the importance of doing work with integrity.

After college, Ryan entered the financial services industry through life, health, and long-term care insurance. He later moved into leadership, training and developing other professionals before obtaining his securities licenses and expanding the scope of his work with clients. In 2021, he shifted his focus fully toward serving clients and earned his CFP® certification. He later pursued the WMCP® and RICP® designations to deepen his knowledge of wealth management and retirement income planning.

Today, Ryan works with people facing a range of financial decisions, including retirement transitions, business ownership, inherited assets, investment management, charitable giving, estate considerations, healthcare costs, and Social Security. His approach combines technical planning with the curiosity that grew from his study of philosophy. He wants to understand the person behind the financial plan and what they want their resources to accomplish.

Ryan and his wife, Emily, married in 2017 and made their home in Syracuse. They welcomed their daughter, Sylvia, in December 2024. Through Green Heron Wealthways and Savvy, Ryan is building the independent advisory practice he envisioned for his community.

Name: Sam Saleh
Intro description: Hi, I’m Sam, a wealth manager in Newport Beach, California. I’m passionate about helping individuals, families, and business owners with their investment, retirement, tax, estate, and small business succession planning. As a fiduciary Chartered Financial Consultant (ChFC®), I hold myself to the highest standard of excellence in financial planning and guidance for my clients.
Quote: To effectively help clients achieve their financial goals, I believe it’s essential to deploy a combination of strategic financial, investment, and tax planning methods tailored to their unique needs.
Service description 1: Transition into your golden years with confidence. Our goal is to see to it that you’re prepared for the unpredictable. Let us turn your retirement dreams into actionable plans.
Service eyebrow 2: PRESERVATION OF YOUR LEGACY
Service description 2: We specialize in making the often complex and emotionally charged process of trust and estate planning as seamless as possible ensuring the security and preservation of a client's legacy for future generations.
Service description 3: Building a successful business is an incredible feat, but what happens to your hard-earned legacy when you're ready to step down? We build strategic blueprints to help ensure the continued growth and success of your enterprise.
Full description:
Sam Saleh is an experienced financial advisor, wealth manager, and seasoned entrepreneur with a diverse career spanning the financial services, construction, interiors and luxury furniture sectors. Currently, Sam leverages his extensive experience to provide comprehensive financial planning and wealth management services to high-net-worth individuals and families.Before transitioning into the financial advisory space, Sam was the CEO of a leading interior fit-out company, overseeing business growth, strategic direction, and operational management. He also founded a luxury interior & furniture company, gaining significant experience in funding, scaling, and exiting businesses.

Sam began his career with wirehouse & insurance firms like Merrill Lynch and New York Life, where he developed specialized skills in financial and risk management planning. During his tenure at these firms, Sam honed his expertise in investment strategies, insurance solutions, and wealth preservation for high-net-worth clients. His work in these areas laid the foundation for his current role as a trusted financial advisor and wealth manager.

Sam holds an MBA from California Polytechnic State University (Cal Poly) and a Chartered Financial Consultant (ChFC®) certification from the American College of Financial Services. His diverse education, combined with his broad business and financial experience, enables him to take a holistic approach to wealth management, focusing not only on financial growth, but also risk mitigation and long-term asset preservation.

With a passion for empowering clients to achieve financial security and success, Sam works closely with each client to develop tailored strategies that address their unique goals and challenges.
Faq answer 1:
With a diverse background spanning the construction industry and entrepreneurship, I have built a solid foundation in leadership and business management. After earning my MBA from Cal Poly, I was presented with global opportunities that led me to work overseas in various C-suite roles, including founding and successfully growing two business ventures over 13 years. My passion for the financial services industry eventually drew me to wirehouse firms. Still, it was upon returning to Southern California with my family that I chose to pivot into financial services.

At New York Life Securities, I honed my risk management and financial planning experience, providing clients with strategic solutions aimed at helping them safeguard their wealth. To further deepen my knowledge and refine my investment strategies, I joined Merrill Lynch, where I expanded my capabilities and built a robust client base. Today, as a Wealth Manager at Savvy, I leverage my unique blend of business acumen and financial expertise to deliver tailored, comprehensive wealth management solutions that help clients achieve their financial goals and build a lasting legacy.
Faq answer 2: I specialize in working with high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth individuals, including C-suite executives, family offices, foundations and endowments, startup founders, and small business owners. My focus is on delivering highly personalized financial planning and investment strategies designed to address the distinct needs of each client. By offering tailored solutions, I help optimize wealth management, enhance asset protection, and ensure seamless wealth transfer across generations.
Faq answer 3:
As a financial planner and wealth manager, my experience spans a wide range of specialized areas tailored to meet the unique needs of high-net-worth (HNW) and ultra-high-net-worth (UHNW) individuals.

These include:

Comprehensive Wealth Management: Crafting personalized financial strategies that integrate investment management, tax efficiency, and asset protection to target asset preservation and growth across generations.

Retirement and Income Planning: Designing customized retirement solutions that ensure long-term financial security, with a focus on income optimization and risk mitigation for a sustainable lifestyle.

Estate and Legacy Planning: Developing strategic estate plans endeavoring to preserve family wealth, minimize estate taxes, and ensure a seamless wealth transfer to future generations, while addressing both philanthropic goals and family dynamics.

My other areas of expertise include tax optimization strategies, investment management, business succession and exit planning, and more.

My goal is to provide a holistic and personalized approach to wealth management that addresses the complexities of HNW and UHNW clients, ensuring financial success both today and for future generations.

I also hold a Chartered Financial Consultant (ChFC) from the American College of Financial Services.
Faq answer 4:
To help clients achieve their financial goals, I employ a comprehensive approach that integrates strategic financial, investment, and tax planning tailored to each individual’s unique circumstances and objectives.

Through goal-based financial planning, I work with clients to clearly define their objectives, understand their risks and prioritize savings and investments accordingly. I then recommend a range of investment strategies based on their investment profile—such as strategic/tactical asset allocation models, dollar-cost averaging, direct indexing, alternative investments, options hedging, equity buffering, and bond laddering strategies to optimize growth, income and manage risk.

Given the increasing importance of tax efficiency, I utilize a variety of sophisticated strategies to help minimize the tax impact on investment gains. These include tax-bracket management, tax-deferred accounts, tax-loss harvesting, capital gains planning, and Roth conversions, all designed to maximize after-tax net returns, where appropriate.

In addition, I focus on estate planning and wealth transfer strategies, including the use of trusts, life insurance, gift tax exclusions, and charitable giving. These tools allow clients to transfer wealth to heirs and philanthropic causes while minimizing tax liabilities.

By combining these strategies, my goal is to grow and preserve wealth, minimize taxes, and ensure financial security at every stage of life. Customizing these solutions to align with each client’s specific situation, risk tolerance, and long-term goals is key to delivering sustained financial outputs.
Faq answer 5:
My favorite part about working with clients is the opportunity to truly make a difference in their lives by helping them achieve their financial goals and secure their future. It's incredibly rewarding to build long-term relationships based on trust, and to know that the strategies we implement together are helping them navigate life’s transitions—whether it’s preparing for retirement, growing their wealth, or creating a lasting legacy for future generations.

What I find especially fulfilling is the opportunity to customize solutions for each client’s unique needs, values, and aspirations. Every conversation is an opportunity to better understand their vision, and to craft a plan that not only helps them achieve their financial goals but also aligns with their personal story. The collaborative nature of the relationship allows me to continuously evolve and adapt strategies, which keeps the work dynamic and impactful.

At the end of the day, it’s about building a partnership where clients feel confident, informed, and empowered to make decisions that support their long-term success—whether that’s through smart investment strategies, tax planning, or wealth transfer solutions. That’s what drives me every day.
Faq answer 6:
Savvy is a fintech industry disruptor that brings AI-powered platforms to the wealth management ecosystem, giving advisors and clients a seamless engagement experience on the front and back end. In my opinion, superior customer service is a hallmark that sets Savvy apart from the noise in the financial services market.

I like that Savvy is a fintech start-up founded by an entrepreneur who had two successful start-up exits under his belt, backed-up by heavy-weight VC firms.I always wanted to be part of a startup and contribute to the growth and success story. Working for a startup means having close contact with leadership and therefore more pulse on the business direction and developing family knit relationships. Less bureaucracy and silos culture means more room for innovation, collaboration and inspiration.

Name: Sandee Mapp
Intro description: Hi there! I’m Sandee Mapp, a Wealth Advisor from San Diego, California, specializing in holistic financial planning, portfolio management, and retirement planning. My passion for financial advising stems from the positive impact a financial advisor had on my life. After seeing close friends face financial complications from life’s unexpected events, I wanted to help others become more educated and strategic around their finances. For over a decade, I’ve had the privilege of guiding clients to build wealth intentionally and sustainably.

Full description:
Sandee’s journey into financial advising was deeply personal, inspired by the positive impact a good advisor had on her life. Sandee graduated from the University of San Diego with a Bachelor's of Business Administration with concentrations in finance and marketing. She also holds a Master's Certification in Project Management from George Washington University.

After years of success in financial services and consulting, unexpected layoffs prompted reflection on life's uncertainties. Witnessing her friends' face early retirement or career shifts underscored the importance of proactive financial planning. This motivated her to pivot into advising, focusing on helping others gain clarity, confidence, and security—especially during life’s transitions.

Over the past 11 years, Sandee has been privileged to guide clients, particularly women and those in underserved communities, in building wealth intentionally and sustainably, so they can navigate change with peace of mind. Sandee loves her clients and utilizes a holistic approach to retirement planning. Her plans focus on income planning, investment management, tax optimization planning, health and long-term care planning, and estate planning while realizing that “Life Happens.”

When Sandee is not working, she enjoys spending time with family and friends. She actively supports many local youth sporting and non-profit organizations.

Name: Scott Eichler
Intro description:
Hi there 👋 I'm Scott. I help Southern California property owners defer the tax on a property sale, without forcing them into a rushed 1031 exchange, or a property they don't want to manage.

I specialize in 1031 exchanges, Delaware Statutory Trusts (DSTs), and Qualified Opportunity Zones for real estate owners across Los Angeles, Orange County, San Diego, and the Inland Empire. Realtors and CPAs also send clients my way when a transaction has tax issues, lending problems, or a client that wants to sell and wants to stop managing property.
Service description 1: We excel in assisting real estate investors with mapping out their financial futures, whether by developing exit strategies for property sales, facilitating pre-purchase property evaluations, or revealing hidden opportunities.
Service eyebrow 2: STRIVING TO MINIMIZE YOUR TAX BURDEN
Service description 2: We aim to take the ambiguity out of tax planning by utilizing tax-reducing strategies that encompass your overall tax liability. We do it by putting together a game plan that is specific to your needs.
Service description 3: Whether it's transferring assets to kids or grandkids, or maximizing your charitable donations, we have the expertise with complex strategies surrounding wealth transfer.
Service eyebrow 4: TAKE CONTROL OF YOUR FINANCIAL FUTURE
Service description 4: Personalized wealth management helps our clients protect their assets. We use a holistic approach to financial planning that integrates tax strategy, trust & estate planning, and risk management.
Full description: Scott Eichler is a financial advisor based in Southern California, specializing in 1031 exchanges, Delaware Statutory Trusts, and tax-deferred real estate transactions. Over nearly two decades in wealth management, he's built a practice around helping property owners across Los Angeles, Orange County, San Diego, and the Inland Empire navigate a sale without a rushed exchange or a property they don't want. Realtors and CPAs regularly refer clients to Scott when a transaction raises a tax question outside their own scope. His practice, Standing Oak Advisors, gives clients tools to see their numbers and their options before they ever get on a call: a calculator that estimates what they'd owe, and a decision tree that narrows down which strategy fits.

I also work closely with realtors and CPAs, who bring clients to me when a transaction raises questions outside their comfort zone.
Faq answer 3: 1031 exchanges, Delaware Statutory Trusts, Qualified Opportunity Zones, and tax-deferred strategies for real estate transactions.

Scott Jensen, Founder of Renovate Financial Planning, powered by Savvy Wealth, is dedicated to helping real estate investors, small business owners, and high-income professionals achieve their financial goals with clarity and confidence. Scott’s tailored strategies, including rental portfolio analysis, tax-efficient real estate transactions, and passive investment transitions, ensure clarity and success.

Name: Sean O’Connor
Intro description: Hi there! I’m Sean O’Connor, a Wealth Advisor from San Diego, California, specializing in income planning, tax management, life transitions, and other strategies for clients approaching or in retirement. My client's trust means everything to me. Whether it's cheering on their successes or counseling them during difficult periods, I love helping people navigate the complexity of financial decision-making.
Quote: At the foundation of my client relationships is a comprehensive financial plan that includes a complete balance sheet, cash flow projections, and investment recommendations.
Service description 1: Transition into your golden years with confidence. Our goal is to see to it that you’re prepared for the unpredictable. Let us turn your retirement dreams into actionable plans.
Service eyebrow 2: UNDERSTAND YOUR INCOME STREAMS
Service description 2: Understand your income with an annual plan showing where cash flow is generated, and why. This weaves together social security, pensions, rental properties, and disbursements from your portfolio to meet your spending needs as efficiently as possible.
Service eyebrow 3: STRIVING TO MINIMIZE YOUR TAX BURDEN
Service description 3: We aim to take the ambiguity out of tax planning by utilizing tax-reducing strategies that encompass your full financial picture. We do it by putting together a game plan that is specific to your personal tax situation and retirement income plan.
Service eyebrow 4: STRATEGIC, DATA-DRIVEN INVESTING TO TARGET AMBITIOUS RESULTS
Service description 4: End-to-end investment management focused on tailoring portfolios to each client’s specific risk tolerance, tax situation, cash flow and liquidity needs.Our comprehensive approach will take into consideration all facets of your situation to give you the appropriate portfolios to execute your financial plan.
Full description:
Sean O’Connor is a Wealth Manager in San Diego, California, well-versed across retirement planning, investment risk management, tax optimization, legacy planning, and other strategies for pre-retirees and retirees.

In 2008, Sean graduated from the University of Southern California with a degree in Economics. His career began supporting his parents’ retirement planning advisor, whose business was growing. During the financial crisis, Sean witnessed firsthand that individuals with a plan generally had better outcomes compared to others who didn’t have a plan and let emotions drive financial decisions. This experience solidified Sean’s approach as a voice of reason in times of uncertainty by simplifying the complexities around financial decision-making.

Outside of work, Sean is happily married with four children. He also loves staying active by hiking, mountain biking, playing beach volleyball, skiing, and playing classical piano.
Faq answer 1: In 2008, I graduated from the University of Southern California with a Bachelor of Science in Economics. My parents’ retirement planning advisor had a growing business, so they gave me an opportunity to learn and support their business. During the financial crisis, I observed how many of our clients who had a plan in place tended to have generally better outcomes than individuals who let their emotions take over during financial decision-making. When I saw the impact I could have on clients' lives as a voice of reason during times of uncertainty, I knew I had found my career calling to help people navigate the complexity of financial decision making, especially in retirement.
Faq answer 2: I primarily work with individuals and families who are approaching retirement or are already retired. For pre-retirees, I’m able to provide clarity for their financial picture and progress towards goals. For retirees, I’m able to provide peace of mind to clients who understand their money is being actively  managed so they can live comfortably in retirement, without the fear of running out of money before they run out of time.
Faq answer 3: My expertise spans many areas across retirement planning, including income planning, tax optimization, and legacy planning. I also hold expertise in pension options analysis, asset transfer strategies, social security timing, and Roth conversion strategies.
Faq answer 4: I enjoy the autonomy and authority Savvy provides to do what is in the best interest of my clients at all times.
Faq answer 5: My favorite part about working with clients is the relationships and connections that I’ve built with them. I love the peace of mind my clients have knowing they have a plan in place, so they can focus on living their life, knowing that their money is being appropriately cared for.

Full description:
Stanford McCullough, JD, CFP®, specializes in income tax planning, wealth transfer and estate planning, philanthropic planning, and asset management for families and entrepreneurs.

Stanford earned his law degree from the S.J. Quinney College of Law at the University of Utah and later completed an LL.M. in Taxation from the University of California, Irvine. He currently serves as Treasurer/Secretary of the Tax Section of the Utah State Bar.

He earned his bachelor’s degree from Utah Valley University in Personal Financial Planning, with a minor in Business Management, and became a CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER™ professional during his undergraduate studies.

By combining his CFP® designation with advanced legal training in taxation, Stanford helps clients navigate complex financial decisions with clarity—especially when taxes, investments, and long-term legacy planning intersect.

Outside of work, Stanford enjoys spending time with his wife skiing, mountain biking, scuba diving, canyoneering, and playing sports.

Intro description: I'm Steve Holdsworth, a CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER® professional and fee-only fiduciary with over 30 years in financial services. I partner with my clients to help them design and simplify their financial lives in an increasingly complex world. Through holistic planning, wealth management, and tax-efficient strategies, I work to help you achieve financial wellbeing.

Full description:
Steve Holdsworth is a CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER® professional, and, as a fiduciary, committed to putting his clients' best interests first. With over 30 years in financial services and 23 years specifically in wealth management, he has helped individuals and families meet their personal financial goals. As a Wealth Manager in partnership with Savvy, Steve works with clients to design and simplify their financial lives in an increasingly complex world.

Before partnering with Savvy, Steve spent 14 years serving wealth management clients on behalf of one of Memphis' largest independent, fee-only Registered Investment Advisors, where he earned the title of Partner and Managing Director. After relocating to the Pacific Northwest, he served as Lead Advisor, Senior Financial Planner, and Financial Advisor for three Seattle-based Registered Investment Advisors. Steve has also served as a CFP® Certificate Program Adjunct Faculty member at Christian Brothers University.

Steve specializes in holistic financial planning, retirement cash flow planning, tax optimization, estate and trust planning, investment management, and protection planning. He works primarily with high net worth, affluent, and emerging affluent clients, particularly those in transition such as individuals approaching retirement, retirees, executives in the tech industry, and business owners. His approach is to lead with holistic planning to help clients achieve, maintain, and live what's most important to them through financial wellbeing.

Steve holds a Bachelor of Business Administration degree in Finance from the University of Texas and an MBA in Financial & Estate Planning from the University of Dallas. He has held the Chartered Life Underwriter® certification as well as FINRA Series 6, 63, 7, 66, and SIE licenses. Outside of work, Steve loves spending time with his family and exploring the Pacific Northwest, including camping, hiking, kayaking, biking, and playing golf.

Whether it’s financial planning, tax-efficient investment strategies, or mutual funds/ETFs, I enjoy sharing my expertise with clients and helping them enjoy retirement with confidence.

Full description:
Steve Marcou is a Wealth Manager with nearly two decades of experience as a financial advisor. His journey to becoming a financial advisor was inspired by his own experience using one. Seeing the value financial advisors provide in helping others achieve their financial goals, Steve wanted to do the same.

He began his career in 2006 at AXA Advisors working with insurance companies for four years and then in banking four years after. Having worked through three bear markets over his nearly double-decade career, Steve has a wealth of knowledge in navigating markets and helping retirees manage their assets.

Most recently, he worked at TIAA where he built a passion for working with retired professors managing their 403(b) accounts. Outside of work, Steve is huge on family, friends and his faith. He loves to spend time with his four children. He also loves to stay active and is a big sports fan, with rooting interests for the Cincinnati Reds, Cincinnati Bengals, and the Ohio State Buckeyes.

Hello 👋🏼 I’m Steve. I specialize in investment management, retirement planning, and portfolio strategies tailored to help individuals, families, and small business owners achieve their goals. Many of my clients are saving for retirement or their children’s education, while others are already in retirement, focused on protecting their wealth and creating a reliable income stream. I also partner with business owners to design and manage workplace retirement plans that support both them and their employees.

My approach is methodical and personalized, ensuring every plan reflects each client’s unique needs. At the heart of my work is building lasting relationships and helping people move forward with confidence.

Steve works with individuals, families, and business owners in the areas of financial planning, investment and portfolio management, and retirement services. His primary clients are those saving for their retirement and their children’s education, as well as those in retirement working to both protect their investments and generate a consistent retirement income stream. Steve also works extensively with small business owners and their employees to design, implement and manage workplace retirement plans.

Steve is a 1986 graduate of Bowling Green State University with a Bachelors in Communications. He also graduated from Wheaton College Graduate School in 1990 with a Masters in International Relations. His credentials from the American College for Financial Services include the Accredited Asset Management Specialist (AAMS) designation and the Chartered Retirement Planning Counselor (CRPC) designation.

Steve is passionate about international missions and has traveled to 30 countries, often in the role of providing aid and relief services. His past experience includes working with the International Red Cross and the US government response team for domestic disasters.

Steve resides in Fishers, Indiana with his wife, Susan, and together they have five children and 4 grandchildren. Steve and Susan enjoy traveling and gardening and Steve is an avid hiker and adventurer, including summiting Kilimanjaro, hiking to Everest Base Camp, and traversing the Grand Canyon.

Name: Steven Harp
Intro description:
Hi, I’m Steven. As the Founder and CEO of Colorado Wealth Group, my vision is to make a positive impact on the community by serving as a true fiduciary to our clients and their goals. We focus on personalized financial planning designed to help our clients navigate life’s decisions with confidence and purpose.
My approach centers on building long-term relationships, simplifying complex financial topics, and creating strategies that align with what matters most to each client.
Quote: I believe great financial planning should provide clarity, confidence, and peace of mind.

Full description:
Steven Harp is the Founder and Chief Executive Officer of Colorado Wealth Group. He graduated from the University of Missouri in 2004 and has since built a robust advisory practice grounded in fiduciary responsibility, education, and personalized service.

Steven is a CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER® professional and holds several advanced industry designations, including ChFC®, CLU®, AIF®, and CLTC®. These credentials allow him to deliver comprehensive advice across investments, retirement planning, tax planning, insurance, estate considerations, and long-term care strategies.

In addition to serving clients, Steven is passionate about continuing education and mentoring, helping develop advisors within Colorado Wealth Group to ensure consistent, high-quality client experiences.

Every strategy is customized to reflect each client’s priorities and circumstances.
Faq answer 5: My favorite part is helping clients feel confident about their financial future. Providing peace of mind—knowing there is a clear plan in place and a trusted partner guiding them—is incredibly rewarding.
